t01-apar-0: LITTAFIN BAYANI NA Hotunan Taimako na Delmas ❦ JERI NA FARKO
t01-apar-1: HOTO Na 1 Makaranta, makarantar sakandare, ajin karatu.
t01-01-1: 1. — Wannan hoto yana nuna **ajin karatu** a **makarantar sakandare**. A cikin wannan aji akwai **tebura** (18) takwas da **benci** (32) takwas. A kan kowane benci ɗalibai uku suke zaune. **Malami** (7) yana zaune a kan **kujera** (8) a **teburinsa** (6) .
t01-02-1: 2. — A hannun hagu na teburin malami akwai **kabad** (15) **mai gilashi**. A hannun dama kuwa akwai **baƙin allo** (1) tare da **abin gogewarsa** (2) da **allinsa** (3) .
t01-02-2: A saman teburin malami an rataya **hotunan bango** ( 9 , 11 , 12 ) da **taswira** (10) .
t01-03-1: 3. — Ba dukan ɗalibai ne suke zaune a **wurarensu** (17) ba. Ioannes (4) yana tsaye a gaban baƙin allo ; yana riƙe da **abin gogewa** yana share **siffofin lissafi.**
t01-03-2: Petrus yana kusa da teburin malami ; yana tara **aikin rubutu** (5) yana kai wa malami.
t01-04-1: 4. — **Wannan** malami malamin **harsuna masu rai** ne. Yana koya wa ɗalibai su yi magana, su karanta su kuma rubuta harsunan waje **(Jamusanci, Turanci, Sifaniyanci, Italiyanci, Rashanci ko Faransanci)**.
t01-05-1: 5. — Ajin karatu yana da faɗi sosai kuma yana da haske sosai. A ƙarshen ɗakin akwai **taga** mai faɗi da **ƙananan tagogi** (78) biyu da **ƙofa mai gilashi** domin shaƙar iska da haskaka shi.
t01-05-2: Wannan aji ba mai sanyi ba ne. A tsakiyarsa, domin ɗumama shi, akwai **murhu** (46) mai kyau sosai tare da **bututunsa** (45) .
t01-05-3: A bango an kafa **ƙugiyoyin tufafi** (58) ; a kansu ne aka rataya huluna da rigunan ɗalibai.
t01-06-1: 6. — **Agogo** (63) yana nuna ƙarfe tara da minti biyar.
t01-06-2: **Lokacin hutu** (76) ya ƙare yanzu, darasi kuma ya sake farawa. Wurin wasa yana cikin **filin makaranta** (75) . Muna ganin waɗansu ɗalibai suna wasa. **Mai kula da ɗalibai** (74) yana sa musu ido.
t01-07-1: 7. — A filin makaranta muna kuma ganin waɗansu mutane, wato **mai duba makarantu** (73) , **shugaban makaranta** (71) da **mataimakin shugaba** (72) .
t01-07-2: Mai dubawa yana duba makarantu, shugaban makaranta yana jagorantar makarantar sakandare, mataimakinsa kuwa yana kula da karatu.
t01-07-3: Mutum na huɗu shi ne **mai gadin ƙofa** (77) . Yana ɗauke da littafin rajista a hammatarsa domin ya rubuta sunayen waɗanda ba su zo ba.
t01-08-1: 8. — A ƙarshen filin akwai **kayan motsa jiki** (70) da ma’aikatar **aikin hannu** (69) .
t01-08-2: A hannun dama na wannan hoto mun fara ganin **ajujuwan** karatun **waƙa** da na **zane**.
t01-09-1: 9. — Ɗalibai da suke a benci na farko a hannun dama na teburin malami su ne **Henrikus** (*) , **Stefanus** da **Karolus.**
t01-09-2: Henrikus yana da hankali sosai kuma mai ƙwazo ne ; yana sauraron malami. A kan teburinsa akwai **littafin rubutu** (28) , **littafi** (29) , **ƙamus** (30) da **akwatin alƙalami** (31) . Littafinsa yana da **shafuka** masu yawa ; kowane babi yana ɗauke da **sakin layi** da dama, kowane **layi** kuma yana da **kalmomi** masu yawa.
t01-09-4: Maƙwabcinsa, Stefanus (24) , mai himma ne. Yana rubuta darasin gobe a littafin rubutunsa. **Rubutunsa** yana da kyau. Littafinsa a rufe yake ; **murfinsa** (27) kaɗai muke gani. Kusa da shi akwai **kwamfansa** (26) .
t01-09-5: Karolus (23) yana riƙe da littafinsa da hannu ; yana buɗe shi domin ya sake karanta darasinsa. Kamar kowane ɗalibi, yana da **kwanon tawada** (25) a gabansa. Mai biyayya ne.
t01-10-1: 10. — A teburin da yake gefe akwai **Ludovikus,** **Antonius** da **Paulus.** Ludovikus yana haddar **darasinsa** (22) yana kuma amsa **tambayoyin** malami. Antonius (21) ba shi da hankali ko kaɗan ; wani lokaci ma malami yakan hukunta shi. Paulus (20) **abokin kirki** ne, mai sanyin hali kuma mai taimako. Yana da hankali sosai.
t01-11-1: 11. — A bayan Henrikus akwai **Georgius** (38) . Ba mugun yaro ba ne, amma **mai surutu** ne, marar hankali kuma mai fitina. **Rashin natsuwarsa** da **rashin biyayyarsa** suna kawo **hargitsi** cikin darasi, sau da yawa kuma yakan cancanci **gargaɗi** mai tsanani. **Littafin ƙazamin rubutunsa** (35) datti ne ; yakan **zubar da tawada** a kansa daga **alƙalaminsa** (34) , shi ya sa kullum yake amfani da **robar gogewarsa** (36) ; **jakar littafansa** (33) a yage take, domin shi mai sakaci ne ƙwarai. Me ya sa kuma yake kawo **gidan fensirinsa** (37) cikin ajin **harsuna masu rai?**
t01-11-2: Maƙwabcinsa, Edmundus (39) , ba ya sonsa. Gaskiya ne ɗan ragwanci gare shi, amma shiru yake kuma mai natsuwa ne. Ba ya surutu ; sai dai maimakon ya saurara, ya fi son karanta **labarai** a **littafin karatunsa.**
t01-11-3: Ɗalibi na uku a wannan benci shi ne **Ludovikus** (40) . Mai himma ne. Yana rubutu a kan farar **takarda.** A gabansa ya ajiye **takardar shaƙe tawadarsa** (41) .
t01-12-1: 12. — Ɗaliban benci na biyu, a hannun hagu na malami, ƙanana ne har yanzu. Na farko, ƙaramin **Emilius,** bai iya rubutu sosai ba tukuna ; yana kawo **allonsa** (42) , **fensirin allonsa** da **sosonsa** (43) .
t01-12-2: A gefensa akwai **Augustus** da **Bernardus** (44) . Wannan na ƙarshe yana aiki da kyau, amma **tufafinsa** ba su da kula ko kaɗan.
t01-13-1: 13. — A bayansu akwai **ragwaye** uku. **Albertus** ba ya haddar darussansa. **Iakobus** (47) yana barci maimakon ya saurara. **Ragwancinsa** yana jawo masa **zargi** har ma da **hukunci.** A ƙarshe **Kristianus** (48) ba shi da kwarjini sam. **Halinsa** mummuna ne kuma bai yi ƙoƙarin gyara kansa ko kaɗan ba.
t01-14-1: 14. — Maƙwabtansa kuwa, akasin haka, masu kyawun hali ne. **Ernestus** (51) yana son tsari da natsuwa ; kullum yakan yi amfani da **rularsa** (50) da **fensirinsa** (49) . **Ɗalibin waje** ne.
t01-14-2: **Franciskus** (52) **ɗalibin kwana** ne ; yana sanye da kayan makaranta, yana ci yana kuma kwana a makarantar sakandare. **Abokin kirki** ne.
t01-14-3: Mauricius yana fera **fensirinsa** da **wuƙarsa** (56) ; mai kula ne ƙwarai.
t01-14-4: Yana kawo dukan littattafansa, **littafin nahawunsa** (55) , **ƙaramin littafin rubutunsa** (54) , har ma da **matashin rubutunsa** (53) . **Jakar makarantarsa** (57) tana ƙasa a bayansa.
t01-14-5: Tebura biyu da suke a ƙarshen aji, **ɗalibai masu kyau** (19) ne suka mamaye su.
t01-15-1: 15. — A **ajin zane** akwai kyawawan **abubuwan koyi** a rataye a bango da **fitila** (62) mai **murfi,** rataye a rufin ɗakin. **Malaminsu** (60) mai haƙuri ne ƙwarai ; yana gyara **zane-zanen** (61) ɗalibai yana kuma koya musu su zana **mutum-mutumi** (59) bisa ga yadda yake a zahiri.
t01-16-1: 16. — **Ajin waƙa** yana da ban sha’awa sosai. A can ake koyon karanta **waƙa,** a rera **alamun sauti** (67) da aka rubuta a kan **layukan waƙa** (do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si = C. D. E. F. G. A. B.), a san **mabuɗan sauti** da rera kyawawan **waƙoƙi.** Ana ajiye takardun waƙa a kan **mariƙin waƙa** (65) . Ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibai yana **bugun fiyano** (64) , **malamin waƙa** (66) kuwa yana **bugun kari** (68) .
t01-17-1: 17. — Mun fara ganin kusurwar **ma’aikata** domin **aikin hannu** (69) , inda yara ke iya koyon sassaƙa itace da nika ƙarfe. Wannan ba ya nan a dukan makarantun sakandare.
t01-18-1: 18. — Malamin lissafi yana koya **wa** ɗalibai **ilimin siffofi, ilimin lissafi, ƙidaya** da **tsarin awo na mita**. A kan allo muna ganin manyan siffofin lissafi : **da’ira** (a) , **murabba’i** (b) , **mai kusurwa uku** (c) , **layi** (d) .
t01-18-2: Muna kuma ganin wani **aikin lissafi** ; ba **haɗawa** ba ne, ba **ragi** ba, ba kuwa **ninkawa** ba — **rabo** (e) ne kuwa.
t01-19-1: 19. — A kan allon tsarin awo na mita muna gani : **mita** (a) , **ma’auni** (b) da **nauyayensa,** **lita** (e) , **dakalita** (f) , **dasilita** da **mita kubi** (d) .
t01-19-2: Ɗalibai suna kuma koyon **ilimin halitta** (11) , ilimin dabbobi (a) , ilimin tsirrai (b) , ilimin ƙasa (c) da **tarihi** (12) .
t01-19-3: A cikin kabad akwai kayan aiki na **kimiyyar lissafi** (15) da na **kimiyyar sinadarai** (16) .
t01-19-4: A kan kabad akwai : **kwallo** (14) , **mazugi** da **kwallon duniya** (13) .
t01-19-5: A saman hotunan an rataya **taswira** mai nuna sassa biyar na duniya : **Turai** (e) , **Asiya** (g) , **Afirka** (f) , **Amirka** ( a b ) da **Osiyaniya** (h) , da manyan tekuna biyu, **Tekun Fasifik** (c) da **Tekun Atlantika** (d) .
t02-apar-1: HOTO Na 2 Jikin ɗan adam. — Lokacin hutu. — Wasanni.
t02-tit-0: Jikin ɗan adam. *(Darasi mai sauƙi na ilimin halitta.)*
t02-01-1: 1. — Manyan sassan jikin ɗan adam su ne : **kai,** **gaɓɓai** da **hannaye da ƙafafu.**
t02-02-1: 2. — Kai yana da sassa biyu : **ƙoƙon kai,** wanda yake ɗauke da **ƙwaƙwalwa** kuma **gashi** ya rufe shi, da **fuska.**
t02-03-1: 3. — A zanenmu ba ma ganin ƙoƙon kai ko ƙwaƙwalwa ; sai dai muna ganin manyan sassan fuska sarai.
t02-04-1: 4. — Ga **goshi** da farko, wanda yake nuna hankali mai ƙarfi da tunani mai aiki kullum. **Gefen goshi** yana da fili sosai. **Ido** yana da rai kuma a buɗe yake sarai. **Gira** mai kauri da **gashin ido** masu tsawo suna kiyaye shi.
t02-05-1: 5. — Ga kuma **hanci** da **ramukan hanci.** Hanci yana taimaka mana mu sunsuna mu kuma numfasa. A kowane gefen hanci akwai **kunci,** can nesa kuma **kunne.** Ƙasan fuska ya ƙunshi **baki** da **haɓa.**
t02-06-1: 6. — Ba ma ganinsu sosai, domin **gashin baki** da **gemu** sun ɓoye mana su. Amma mun san cewa baki yana da **leɓɓa** biyu, **muƙamuƙin sama** da **muƙamuƙin ƙasa** tare da **haƙoransu,** da kuma **harshe.** Da baki muke magana muke kuma cin abinci. Da harshe muke jin ɗanɗanon abinci.
t02-07-1: 7. — Ido, kunne, hanci da baki, kamar yatsu, su ne gaɓɓan hankula biyar : **gani,** **ji,** **sunsuna,** **ɗanɗano,** **taɓawa.**
t02-08-1: 8. — Kai fa yana ɗaya daga cikin sassan jikin ɗan adam mafi ban sha’awa.
t02-09-1: 9. — **Wuya** tana haɗa kai da jiki. Tana ɗauke da **maƙogwaro** da **ƙeya.**
t02-10-1: 10. — Jiki yana kuma ɗauke da gaɓɓai masu muhimmanci da yawa. A cikin **ƙirji** akwai **huhu,** waɗanda muke numfashi da su, da **zuciya,** wadda take tsakiyar rai. Idan zuciya ta daina bugu, mai rai yakan mutu.
t02-12-1: 12. — Sauran sassan jiki su ne **gefe,** **baya,** **kafaɗu** da **ciki.** Muna kwanciya a kan gefe ko a kan baya domin barci, muna kuma ɗaukar kaya a kan kafaɗunmu.
t02-13-1: 13. — A cikin ciki akwai **tumbi** da **hanji.** Suna taimaka mana mu narkar da abinci.
t02-14-1: 14. — Muna da **gaɓɓai** huɗu : **hannaye** biyu da **ƙafafu** biyu. Da hannaye muke ɗauka, muke riƙewa, muke ɗagawa muke kuma tara abubuwa ; da ƙafafu muke tsayawa, muke tafiya muke kuma gudu.
t02-15-1: 15. — **Kafaɗa** tana haɗa hannu da jiki. **Tsoka** mai ƙarfi ƙwarai, wato tsokar hannu, ita ce take motsa hannun da **gwiwar hannu** take haɗawa da **damtse.** **Wuyan hannu** shi ne gaɓar **tafin hannu,** wanda yake ƙarewa da **yatsu** da **farata.** A kan hannu muna rarrabe **jijiya** (da jijiyar jini) inda **jini** yake gudana.
t02-16-1: 16. — Sassan ƙafa su ne : **cinya,** **gwiwa** da **bayan gwiwa,** **dunƙulen ƙafa,** wanda **namansa** yake rufe da **fata,** **idon sawu** da **tafin ƙafa.** **Ƙasusuwan** ƙafa suna da kauri kuma suna da ƙarfi ƙwarai. A ƙarshen ƙafa akwai **yatsun ƙafa.** Sauran sassa su ne **tafin sawu** da **diddige.**
t02-17-1: 17. — Haka bayanin jikin ɗan adam yake, kusan gaba ɗaya.
t02-17-2: *Bayani.* — *Da taimakon zancen : « ina jin ciwo a...* *(kai da sauransu) », malami zai iya sake amfani da wannan* *dukan kalmomi daga fuskar* **lafiyar jiki** *mai kyau ko mara kyau.*
t02-tit-4: Motsa jiki. *(Labari daga bakin ɗaya daga cikin ɗalibai.)*
t02-18-1: 18. — Domin mu zama masu sassauƙar jiki, masu saurin motsi kuma masu lafiya, dole mu horar da ƙafafunmu da hannayenmu. Shi ya sa muke wasa muke kuma **motsa jiki.**
t02-19-1: 19. — A cikin mako, waɗannan horo biyu suna gudana a filin makarantar sakandare (duba hoto na 1). Amma ranar Alhamis da ranar Lahadi mukan tafi babban filin ciyawa, inda muke da wuri mu yi gudu mu kuma nishaɗantar da kanmu.
t02-20-1: 20. — Malamanmu da iyayenmu wani lokaci sukan raka mu can ; amma **malamin motsa jiki** (12) shi ne yake jagorantar horon.
t02-21-1: 21. — A kan filin ciyawa, a hannun hagu na ƙofar shiga, akwai **kayan motsa jiki** (1) ; muna hawa **tsani** (2) , muna juyawa a kan **zoban** (3) da a kan **sandar rataya** (4) , muna ɗaga kanmu da hannaye har saman **tsanin igiya** (5) ko na **igiya mai ƙulle-ƙulle** (6) .
t02-22-1: 22. — A halin yanzu, abokanmu suna tsallakawa a kan **dokin katako** (7) ko **sandunan kwance** (11) . Waɗansu suna **dambe** (8) ko **takobin wasa** (9) da abin rufe fuska da **sandar ƙarfe.** A ƙarshe, waɗansu suna **ɗaga nauyi** (10) .
t02-23-1: 23. — Kewaye da masu motsa jiki, yara maza da mata suna wasanni iri iri. ’Yan mata suna nishaɗantar da kansu da **zoben wasa** (14) ; suna tsalle da **igiyar tsalle** (13) ko su gayyaci ƙannensu maza da ƴan uwansu zuwa wasan **kuroke** (15) . Suna jin daɗin turar **ƙwallon** abokin hamayya da **ƙaramin gudumar katakonsu,** a daidai lokacin da yake tsammani zai ratsa ta ƙarƙashin baka cikin sauƙi !
t02-24-1: 24. — Yara maza sun fi son wasannin da suke buƙatar ƙarfi. Suna son wasan **sandunan wasa** (16) da suke kaɗawa da **ƙwallo** (17) cikin gwaninta. Ba sa kuma rena wasan **abin jujjuyawa** (18) da **kama ƙwallo da sanda** (19) ko ma **wasan kwaɗo** (20) . Amma wasannin da suka fi so su ne **wasan tsakuwa** (21) da **ƙwallon bango** (22) , domin bangon **gidan tsirrai** (26) yana da kyau ƙwarai wajen sake turo ƙwallon nan maras nauyi.
t02-25-1: 25. — Ƙaramin Ioannes, yana tafiya a kan **sandunan ƙafarsa** (24) , gwani ne ƙwarai kuma ya iya kiyaye daidaito sosai. Kusa da shi, waɗansu abokai suna wasan **ɓoye** (25) a cikin gidan tsirrai da bayan **shinge.** Waɗansu sun fi son **zaton mai bugu** (28) ko **ƙwallon tashi** (29) , wanda yake tashi daga wannan **raket** zuwa wancan.
t02-26-1: 26. — A tsakiyar filin ciyawa akwai bishiyoyi biyu. A gindin ɗayansu, yara maza bakwai ko takwas sun shirya wasan **tsallen kafaɗa** (30) (*) . Ba a kowace ƙasa ake sanin wannan wasa ba ; amma kowa ya san abin da **tsallen baya** yake, wanda yaran ba su yi wasa da shi ba a wannan karo.
t02-27-1: 27. **Wasan makaho** (31) ma yana da daɗi ƙwarai ; ƴan mata da yara maza suna sa **ɗaurin ido** a idanunsu bi da bi suna kama waɗanda ba su iya tsere ba.
t02-28-1: 28. — A tsakiyar filin ciyawa, ga wasa mai Faransanci ƙwarai amma mai ɗan tsanani : shi ne **wasan beyar** (32) , mai hayaniya fiye da wasan **tsuntsun iska** (33) mai natsuwar nan, ko ma fiye da wasan Turancin nan **tanis** (34) .
t02-29-1: 29. — Wannan wasa na ƙarshe shi ne farin cikin manyan ɗalibai. Malamanmu da kansu suna yin sa da so. Yana buƙatar gwaninta da saurin motsi, ni kuwa ina son sa ƙwarai. Na bar wa ƴan mata wasan **lilo** (35) .
t02-30-1: 30. — Ba na son wani wasan Turanci wanda wataƙila zai zama mai haɗari.
t02-30-1b: Ina nufin **ƙwallon ƙafa** (36) , wanda yake faranta wa babban ɗan uwana rai. Na fi son tsohon **wasan kamun juna** (38) namu, wanda yake da kyau ga lafiya haka nan kuma ba shi da tsanani sosai.
t02-31-1: 31. — Ni ma ina son zagaya filin ciyawa a kan **keke** (37) .
t02-32-1: 32. — A shekara mai zuwa zan koyi **hawan doki** (39) . Doki yana da kyau ƙwarai idan yana takawa ko yana sukuwa cikin annashuwa, kuma idan yana tsallake shamaki da gudu !
t02-33-1: 33. — A lokacin rani muna koyon **iyo** (40) . Muna nutsawa muna kuma yin wanka cikin ruwan kogi mai tsafta da sanyi da daɗi. Wani lokaci a ƙarshe mukan saki **balon takarda** (41) wanda yake hawa sama cikin girma, da zarar an cika shi da iska mai zafi.
t02-34-1: 34. — Akwai kuma wasanni da yawa waɗansu, amma ba zan gama ƙidaya su ba, kuma daga wannan taƙaitawa mutum yakan gane cewa a ranakun Alhamis ba a gundura sosai a kan kyakkyawan filin ciyawarmu.
t02-34-2: N.-B. — *Malami zai iya cika wannan babi cikin sauƙi ; ta* *wurin bayyana kowane ɗaya daga cikin wasannin da suka fi* *muhimmanci daki-daki.*
t03-apar-2: (An haɗa hoto na 3 da na 4 ta yadda suke nuna, cikin **fage huɗu na iyali**, muhimman ra’ayoyi game da **yanayi**, da **shekaru**, da **iyali**, da **tufafi** da **hali**.)
t03-c1-01-1: 1. — Muna cikin **bazara,** a watannin **Maris,** **Afirilu** ko **Mayu,** a ranakun **mako,** **Litinin,** **Talata,** ko **Laraba.** **Ƙarfe goma** na safe ne.
t03-c1-02-1: 2. — **Yanayi** yana da kyau, **iska** tana da tsabta. Rana tana haskakawa. Waɗansu **ƙananan gajimare** (2) suna hawa a cikin shuɗiyar **sama** (1) .
t03-c1-03-1: 3. — **Bishiyoyi** kusan ba su da **ganye.** **Sirarun bishiyoyi** (3) da **dogon icen inuwa** (17) har yanzu ba su da komai sai toho.
t03-c1-04-1: 4. — **Alallaka** (4) suna dawowa suna shawagi cikin ƙwarƙwasa mai farin ciki kewaye da **tsinin** (7) **hasumiyar ƙararrawa** (5) wadda take kambin **cocin** (6) ƙauyen.
t03-c1-05-1: 5. — Wannan coci mai sauƙi ne ƙwarai, tare da **babbar ƙofarsa** (13) da **babban agogonsa** (8) . **Ƙaramar allura** (9) tana kan lamba X, tana nuna **sa’o’i.** **Babbar** (10) tana kan XII (tsakar rana) ; tana nuna **mintuna.**
t03-c1-06-1: 6. — A cikin hasumiya, **ƙararrawa** (11) suna kaɗawa cikin farin ciki. A saman rufin akwai ƙaramin **gicciyen** (12) dutse a tsaye.
t03-c1-07-1: 7. — Coci ba **babbar ƙofa** (13) kaɗai yake da ita ba, yana da ƙaramar ƙofa a gefe. Ta wannan ƙaramar ƙofa ne malam **fada** (15) , sanye da **doguwar rigarsa,** yake fitowa daga **ɗakin tufafi** (14) ya nufi **gidan fada** (19) .
t03-c1-08-1: 8. — Kusa da shi, ga **mai sayar da madara** (24) tare da **jakinta** (23) . Tana dawowa daga gari, inda ta kai madara mai kyau ga yara.
t03-c1-09-1: 9. — Malam Jaki ya gamsu ƙwarai da wannan tafiya ta safe. Yana shaƙar iskar da ƙamshin **furanni** (20) ya ɗebi zaƙi, furannin da suka rufe **itatuwan ƴaƴan itace** (18) na **gonar** maƙwabta. Waɗannan **itatuwan fis** (18) da **itatuwan abirkot** (19) duk ruwan hoda da fari suke, kuma suna ba da tsammanin girbi mai kyau.
t03-c1-10-1: 10. — A halin yanzu, ƙananan **ƙudan zuma** (22) na **amyar zuma** (21) suna zuwa can su tara **zumarsu** mai zaƙi suna ƙara.
t03-c1-11-1: 11. — Amma me ke faruwa ? Ga shi yaran ƙauyen sun yi gudu suka tsoratar da **manyan agwagwa** (25) suka sa su gudu. Fitowar jama’a ce daga coci bayan **baftisman** ɗan magatakarda.
t03-c1-12-1: 12. — Ƙaramin Iakobus, cikin **shimfiɗarsa** (26) , ya farka saboda kaɗawar ƙararrawa mai farin ciki, ƙanwarsa Magdalena kuwa, ita ma tana son ganin jama’ar baftisma, sai ta roƙi mahaifiyarta ta zo ta yi mata kitso ta sa mata tufafi a bakin ƙofar gida.
t03-c1-13-1: 13. — Mahaifiyar ta yarda. Ta sa **ɗankwalinta** (28) , da **rigar jikinta** (29) da **afaronta** (30) , sai ta zo ta zauna a kan ƙaramar kujera gaban ƙofa. Magdalena kuwa ba ta da komai sai **rigar ƙasanta** (31) da **matsattsiyar rigarta** (32) .
t03-c1-14-1: 14. — Kai, farin ciki gare ta ! Ta manta da furanninta da take so, wato **furen kanumfari** (34) , wanda **malam buɗe littafi** (35) yake sauka a kansa, da **tulifinta** (36) , da **furannin Mayunta** (37) cikin **tukwane** (38) a kan **bango** (33) , da **wardinta** (39) da suka yi shinge mai kyau ƙwarai. Tana kallon tufafi masu tsada na matan da suke cikin jama’a.
t03-c1-15-1: 15. — Yaran ƙauyen ba su damu sosai da tufafi ba. Suna gaggawa suna tunkuɗar juna domin su sami **alewa** (55) ko **tsabar kuɗi** (52) . Ɗaya daga cikinsu yana kuka (40) .
t03-c1-16-1: 16. — Wani ya taka ƙafar **kare** (42) , sai kare ya gudu yana kuka ya tsoratar da **kaza** (43) da **ƴaƴanta** (44) .
t03-c1-17-1: 17. — A gaban jama’a akwai **mai reno** (45) . Tana da **kyakkyawar hula** (46) mai dogayen ɗauri. Tana ɗauke da **jaririn da aka haifa** (47) sanye da **lesi** (48) gaba ɗaya.
t03-c1-18-1: 18. — Bayan mai reno sai **uban baftisma** (49) da **uwar baftisma** (53) . Su ne suke rarraba alewa da tsabar kuɗi. Uban baftisma yana da **safar hannu** (51) da **dogon hula** (50) . Uwar baftisma tana riƙe da **gungun furanni** (54) mai kyau a hannu.
t03-c1-19-1: 19. — Bayansu, muna ganin **baffan** (56) da **goggon** (58) yaron. Goggo tana da **hula** (59) mai kwarjini, baffa kuwa yana da **bakar doguwar riga** (57) da farin waskoti. Ga kuma **ɗan baffa** (60) da **ƴar baffa** (61) . Ita kuwa tana riƙe da hannun **ƙanwar** (62) jaririn, wato ƙaramar Berta.
t03-c1-20-1: 20. — **Ɗan uwan** (63) Berta ɗayan yana tafiya a baya. Yana riƙe da hannun wata **ƴar uwa** (64) . **Abokan** (65) iyalin suna zuwa a bayansu.
t03-c1-21-1: 21. — Kusa da jama’a, ga **maroƙi** (66) yana jingina a kan **sandar tallafinsa** (67) . Yana neman sadaka.
t03-c1-22-1: 22. — A ɗaya gefen akwai ƙaramin yaro **mai ladabi** (68) ƙwarai. Yana gaisuwa yana yi wa waɗanda ya sani « **barka da safiya** ».
t03-c1-23-1: 23. — Mutanen ƙauyen sun fito daga gidajensu domin su ga jerin gwanon baftisma. Muna ganin **ɗan ƙauye** (69) sanye da **hular audugarsa,** a gefensa kuma **ƴar ƙauye** (70) . Sai **tsohuwa** (71) jingine a kan **sandarta** (72) . A ƙarshe **mai niƙa** (73) da **babbar hular gashinsa** (74) da wata budurwar ƙauye sanye da **takalman katako** (75) , wadda take koya wa ɗanta tafiya.
t03-c1-24-1: 24. — Wannan fage yana da daɗi ƙwarai.
t03-c2-01-1: 1. — **Rani** ya zo. Zafin rana mai tsanani na watan **Yuni** (**Yuli** ko **Agusta**) yana ƙarfafa samari su yi iyo su kuma tuƙa jirgin ruwa.
t03-c2-02-1: 2. — A gaɓar dama ta kogi, masu tuƙa jirgin ruwa suna tuɓe tufafi domin su shiga wasannin ruwa da gasa.
t03-c2-03-1: 3. — Ɗaya daga cikinsu yana cire **takalmansa** (1) ; yana kwance su. Abokansa biyu sun riga sun yi shiri. Yanzu ba su da komai sai **rigar saƙa** (2) da **wandon iyo** (3) . Suna hira suna jiran abokansu. Suna magana a kan hutu da bikin da yake gudana a ɗaya gaɓar.
t03-c2-04-1: 4. — A ƙasa, kusa da su, ga tufafin abokansu a kwance : **takalman sama** (4) guda biyu, **takalma** (5) , **safa** (6) , **hular gashi** (7) da **hular kaba** (8) da **taye** (9) .
t03-c2-05-1: 5. — Ɗaya daga cikin samarin ya naɗe **kayansa** (10) da kula. Ya ajiye su a kan tawul, wanda maƙwabcinsa zai naɗe kayansa biyu a cikinsa ba da daɗewa ba.
t03-c2-06-1: 6. — Yaro na shida ya yi jinkiri. Har yanzu yana da **kasketinsa** (11) a kai. Bai tuɓe **taguwarsa** (12) ba, ko **kwalar rigarsa** (13) , ko **hannun rigarsa** (14) . Yana riƙe da **waskotinsa** (17) a hannu, har yanzu kuma yana da **wandonsa** (16) da **ɗamararsa** (15) . Lalle ba zai yi shiri ba don gasar da take gabatowa.
t03-c2-07-1: 7. — Kusa da samarin, akwai ƙaramar hanya wadda a gefenta akwai **ciyawar ƙaya** (18) mai yawa, tana kaiwa bakin kogi, inda malam Iakobus yake shirya, cikin **kyauro** (19) , **wasan wuta** (20) da za a harba da yamma.
t03-c2-08-1: 8. — A kan kogi, waɗansu mata, suna kare kansu da laimarsu, suna yawo cikin **jirgin ruwa** (21) . Suna bin gasar da take da ban sha’awa ƙwarai. A cikin kowane **ƙaramin jirgi** (22) , **masu tuƙi** (24) huɗu suna tuƙi da dukan ƙarfinsu, alhali **mai riƙe da linzami** (26) yana riƙe da **linzamin** (25) yana kuma jagorantar jirgin nan mai rauni. **Sandunan tuƙi** (23) suna bugun ruwa cikin kari, jiragen nan marasa nauyi kuwa suna tafiya da sauri mai ban mamaki.
t03-c2-09-1: 9. — Waɗansu samari suna gwagwarmaya, kusa da ginshiƙin gada, a kan ladar **sandar mai** (28) . Ɗaya daga cikinsu yana takawa a hankali a kan sandar nan mai laushi da santsi domin ya kai ga ƙaramar **tuta** (29) da aka ɗaura a ƙarshenta. **Abokin takararsa** (30) mara sa’a ya faɗa cikin ruwa. Yana iyo domin ya fito ƙasa.
t03-c2-10-1: 10. — Samari manya suna **gasar tunkuɗa a ruwa** (32) kusa da **tashar ruwa** (33) . Waɗannan wasanni duka ana kallonsu da **jama’a** (31) mai yawa, jingine a kan **shingen** **gada** (27) kuma taruwa a kan gaɓa. Sai dai waɗansu masu kallo sukan juya domin su bi wasan **sandar lada** (45) ko domin su yaba wa **tawagar magajin gari** wadda take zuwa domin **rabon** kyaututtuka.
t03-c2-11-1: 11. — Da farko, ga waɗansu **yaran gari** (35) a gaban **makaɗa** (36) ; sai **magajin gari** (37) ya biyo, da mataimakansa da **majalisar** ƙaramin garin. A ƙarshe sai **masu kashe gobara** (38) .
t03-c2-12-1: 12. — Mutane da yawa suna kan **filin biki** (39) . Ana zuwa a ga **rumfuna** iri iri : **dawakin katako** (40) , da **sirkas** (41) wanda wasansa ya riga ya fara ; da **wurin rawa** (42) , inda samari da ƴan mata na garin suke jin daɗin **rawa.**
t03-c2-13-1: 13. — A can baya, muna ganin **filin fama** (44) inda **mai fama da bijimi** na Sifaniya mai jaruntaka yake kokawa da **bijimi** (45) mai fushi ; sai **wurin zamiya** (49) , da **wurin harbi** (46) inda ake horar da kai a kan amfani da **bindigogi** da harbi a kan **abin harbi.**
t03-c2-14-1: 14. — A kusa, ga **gidan wasan kwaikwayo** (47) inda ake yin **wasan ban dariya** da **wasan ban tausayi.** Kusa ƙwarai, akwai rumfar **katon mutum** (48) da ta **gajeren mutum.** **Tsawon** na farkon mita biyu da santimita goma sha biyar ne ; na biyun kuwa bai fi yaro girma ba.
t03-c2-15-1: 15. — A ƙarshe, ga babban **gidan namun daji** (50) tare da **namun dajinsa,** da **damisarsa** (51) mai **farata** masu ƙarfi, da **zakinsa** (52) mai **geza** mai kauri, da **raƙuman dawansa** (53) biyu da **giwarsa** (54) wadda take amfani da **hancinta** cikin gwaninta.
t03-c2-16-1: 16. — **Mai horar da namun daji** (55) wanda yake koya wa waɗannan dabbobi yana tsaye a bakin ƙofar rumfar.
t04-c1-01-1: 1. — Samarin sun girma. Ɗaya daga cikinsu, Ioannes, yana yin aure. Muna halartar **bikin aure** wanda ya tara iyalan ango da amarya kewaye da tebur ɗaya.
t04-c1-02-1: 2. — Muna cikin **kaka,** a **watan Satumba.** Iskar sanyi ta **Oktoba** da ta **Nuwamba** ba ta riga ta tuɓe ƙauyen koren ganyensa ba. Iskar yamma tana da ɗumi da ƙamshi ; shi ya sa ake cin abincin dare a ƙarƙashin **baranda** (8) kusa da gona.
t04-c1-03-1: 3. — Can nesa, a kan **tudu** (3) , akwai gidan iyayen Ioannes, **kagara** (1) mai kwarjini ɓoye cikin ganyaye ; kyawawan gonakin inabi, waɗanda suke ba da giya mai kyau ƙwarai, sun rufe gefen tudun. Manomin inabi yana nomansu yana kuma kula da su.
t04-c1-04-1: 4. — A saman gonakin inabi, garken **makwarwa** (2) yana wucewa, tsorace saboda kusatowar **mai gadin farauta** (5) . Shi kuwa, da **bindiga** a hammata da **jakar farauta** a kafaɗa, yana bincika **sarƙaƙƙiya** (4) tare da **karensa** (6) . Yana tsare gonar yana kuma hana ƴan farautar sata su hallaka namun daji.
t04-c1-05-1: 5. — A wajen **baranda,** akwai **shingen inabi** yana hawa, wanda **gungun inabi** (7) masu yawa suke rataye a kansa.
t04-c1-06-1: 6. — Kyawawan furannin kaka, waɗanda suka yi wa **tebur** (16) ado, su ne **furannin kaka** (9) ; **mahaifin** (10) amaryar ya sa ɗaya daga cikinsu a ramin maɓallin rigarsa.
t04-c1-07-1: 7. — Cin abinci yana gab da ƙarewa. **Mai hidima** (11) ya fara kawo kwanonin kayan zaki, ba da daɗewa ba kuma zai ɗauke sassan kayan cin abinci iri iri, **cokula** (14) , **cokali mai yatsa** (12) , **wuƙaƙe** (13) , **manyan faranti** (15) , waɗanda ba a buƙatarsu kuma.
t04-c1-08-1: 8. — Kowa yana da farin ciki a fuska, murmushin da **uwar** (17) angon take yi tana kallon ƴaƴanta kuwa yana tabbatar da farin cikinta.
t04-c1-09-1: 9. — Wannan aure yana haɗa iyalai biyu masu arziki na ƙasar. Ioannes, **angon** (18) , **ɗan** babban mai gona ne, yanzu kuma ya zama **surukin** wani gwanin masana’anta.
t04-c1-10-1: 10. — **Ma’aurata** matasa ne, duk da haka tun da daɗewa aka yi musu **alkawari.** **Amarya** (19) , Martha, tana da kwarjini cikin **farar rigarta** da aka yi wa ado da furannin lemu.
t04-c1-11-1: 11. — **Surukinta** (20) yana farin ciki ƙwarai da ya sami **matar ɗa** mai kirki haka, **surukuwar** (21) Ioannes kuwa tana murmushi tana ganin **ƴarta** da kyau haka.
t04-c1-12-1: 12. — A ƙarshen tebur, **baƙi** (22) sauran suna zaune, wato **dangi, abokai, ƴan baffa, ƴan goggo.** **Shugaban masu hidima** (23) , da tawul a hammata, yana yi musu hidima da himma.
t04-c1-13-1: 13. — A hannun dama na tebur, ga **budurwa** (24) , **abokiyar** amaryar, sai ɗan uwanta, wanda yake **abokin girmamawarta** (25) . Yana hira da **budurwar girmamawarsa** (26) , ƙanwar ango, wadda ta zama **ƴar surukar** Martha ta wurin wannan aure. Budurwa ce mai kwarjini. Tana da kyawawan **kayan ado,** **sarƙar lu’ulu’u,** da **munduwar zinare.**
t04-c1-14-1: 14. — Kusa da su, malamin da yake tsaye yana ɗaga hidorinsa **abokin** (27) iyalin ne. Yana ɗaya daga cikin **shaidun ango.** Yana **gaisuwar sha,** yana sha domin **lafiyar** ma’auratan yana kuma yi musu fatan farin ciki mai dorewa. Sanye yake da kayan biki, da kwat mai wutsiya da **takalma masu ƙyalli** (28) . Shi ne mai raka **kaka** (29) , wadda take **gwauruwa.**
t04-c1-15-1: 15. — Saurayin da yake sanye da **kwat mai wutsiya** (31) , mai ɗan baƙin gashin baki, shi ne **surukin** (30) Ioannes. Injiniya ne fitacce. Shi ne maƙwabcin wata **matashiyar mace** (33) mai kwarjini ƙwarai, wato **yayar** Martha kuma mahaifiyar ƙaramar yarinyar nan mai kyau wadda take zuwa, hannu da hannu da ɗan baffanta, ta miƙa fure ta kuma **yi masa fatan barka da yamma.** Wannan mace tana da kyawawan **ƴan kunne** da **ɗaurin kai** mai kwarjini.
t04-c1-16-1: 16. — Ƙaramin ɗan baffan nan, mai ban mamaki saboda **rigar samansa** (36) da **gajeren wandonsa** (37) mai kumbura, abin tausayi ne ƙwarai. **Maraya** (35) ne. Tun yana ƙarami ya rasa mahaifinsa da mahaifiyarsa. Baffansa shi ne **mai riƙonsa** (38) , wanda bai yi aure ba domin ya reni yaron nan mai tausayi. Mutum ne mai kirki. Ɗan sanƙo ne kuma ba ya gani da nisa ; yana amfani da **tabarau mai maƙale.**
t04-c1-17-1: 17. — A bayan masu biki, a kan tebur da aka rufe da **zanen tebur,** an shirya **kayan zaki** (39) . A cikin babbar kwarya, ga ƴaƴan itace, **fis** (40) , **fir** (41) , **tuffa** (42) , **abirkot** (43) da **inabi** (44) . A kusa, **abarba** (45) , **kek** (46) mai kyau, **kwalaben giya** (48) da **ruwan inabi mai kumfa** (49) da kuma jerin **faranti** (47) masu tsabta.
t04-c1-18-1: 18. — **Mai riƙe da kwalabe** (50) yana buɗe **kwalaban** (52) tsohuwar giya da **abin cire matoshi** (51) . **Matoshin** (53) ya yi kama da mai wuyar cirewa ƙwarai. Wannan mutum yana da **tawul** (54) a hammata.
t04-c1-19-1: 19. — Bayan cin abincin dare, maza za su tafi ɗakin shan taba, mata kuwa za su tafi su yi shirin rawa.
t04-c2-01-1: 1. — Shekaru goma sun shuɗe, iyayen Ioannes sun tsufa suna kuma son jikokinsu uku ƙwarai, wato **jikoki maza** (2) biyu da **jikanya** (3) guda. Domin yau **ranar haihuwar kaka** ce, ƴaƴansu sun zo su yi masa fatan barka da ranar haihuwa.
t04-c2-02-1: 2. — Ƙaramin Petrus ƙarami ne har yanzu, shekarunsa uku kacal. Yana ganin **kyanwa** (1) tana kusatowa. Yana son ya shafa mata kyakkyawan **gashinta** mai laushi da doguwar **wutsiyarta,** bai lura ba cewa a ƙarƙashin **ƙafafunta** masu kwarjini akwai farata masu kaifi ɓoye waɗanda wataƙila za su kakkaɓe shi.
t04-c2-03-1: 3. — Ƙanwarsa Gabriela, wadda take riƙe da hannunsa, ta fi shi natsuwa ƙwarai, Marcellus kuwa da babbar **alkyabbarsa** (4) da **ɗamararsa** (5) ta fata ya yi kama da wanda ya girma, duk da gajeren wandonsa wanda yake bayyana **safarsa** (6) .
t04-c2-04-1: 4. — Mahaifinsu ya sa **kwat na sanyi** (7) mai kauri na hunturu tare da **kwalar gashi** (8) , a cikin **aljihunsa** (9) kuma yana da ɗankwali. Matarsa tana da hularta ta gashi da aka yi wa ado da **gashin tsuntsu** (10) , da **jaketarta** (11) , da **mayafin gashinta** (12) da **abin ɗumama hannunta** (13) .
t04-c2-05-1: 5. — Ana sanyi ƙwarai, domin hunturu ne. **Dusar ƙanƙara** (19) ta yi ta sauka tsawon yini, rufin gidaje kuwa duk ya yi fari. Tare da **dare,** sanyi yana ƙara tsanani. A sararin sama, **wata** (17) da **taurari** (18) suna haske suna ratsa **duhu.**
t04-c2-06-1: 6. — **Makaho** (20) mai tausayin nan da yake ratsa filin gaban **kantin magani** (16) , **ƙaramin karensa** (21) yana jagorantarsa, bai da sa’a ko kaɗan. Iustinia, **mai aikin gida** (14) , tana kawo daga ɗakin girki **kwano** (15) na **shayin ganye** mai zafi ƙwarai da aka sa masa sukari da yawa.
t04-c2-07-1: 7. — **Kaka** (23) tana son neman **tabarau mai hannunta** (26) a kan tebur, domin ta karanta **takardar magani** (27) da **likita** (25) ya rubuta yanzu, sai ta tashi daga babbar kujerarta, tana jingina a kan **sandarta** (24) .
t04-c2-08-1: 8. — Sau da yawa tana fama da **ƙananan ciwo, jiri, mura, ciwon haƙori,** ƙafafunta sun raunana idanunta kuma ba su da kyau kuma. Duk da haka, tana yi wa tsohon **likitanta** ba’a da so, shi da yake so ya rubuta mata **maganin sha** (28) kullum. Yau tana farin ciki ƙwarai domin tana da ƙaramin iyalinta kewaye da ita.
t04-c2-09-1: 9. — Ana jin daɗi cikin ɗakin da aka rufe da kyau. A cikin **murhun bango** (29) na dutsen marmara, **wuta mai kyau** (30) tana ci, mutum kuwa yana jin daɗi cikin **hasken** **fitila** (31) mai sanyi da aka kunna yanzu.
t04-c2-10-1: 10. — Har **kaka** (33) da kansa ya manta cewa yana da ciwo, cewa **amosaninsa** ya ɗaure shi a kan **babbar kujerarsa** (34) kuma cewa jiya ma yana da **zazzaɓi da suma.** Bai kuma tuna cewa a hunturun da ya wuce ya sha **ciwon huhu** kuma **tari** mai ƙarfi da wahala ya sa shi shan azaba ƙwarai.
t04-c2-10-2: Duk da haka da wuya sosai aka warkar da shi. Yanzu yana cikin sauƙi. Amma ƙafarsa wadda yake jingina a kan **matashi** (38) da aka ajiye a kan ƙaramar **kujera** (39) tana ba shi ciwo ita ma.
t04-c2-11-1: 11. — Idan an lulluɓe shi da kula cikin **rigar ɗakinsa** (35) mai ɗumi tare da **maɓalli** (36) masu kauri na lu’ulu’u, kuma idan yana da kusa da shi, domin ta karanta masa jarida, ƙaramar **marayar** (40) nan sanye da farar **hula,** da shuɗiyar **riga** (42) da **mayafi** (41) , ba ya gunaguni.
t04-c2-12-1: 12. — Kowace shekara, idan **kalanda** (43) ya sake nuna **kwanan watan** ranar farko ga **Disamba,** yakan jira **jikokinsa** ba tare da haƙuri ba, domin ya san cewa ba za su manta da wannan **kwanan wata** mai muhimmanci ba.
t04-c2-13-1: 13. — Yakan tuna da tausayi lokacin nan na dā sosai da shi da kansa ya je ya yi wa **babban hafsan** sarki mai ɗaukaka fatan barka da biki, wanda **hotonsa** (44) yake rataye a bango, kuma wanda yake **kakan kakan** ƴaƴansa.
t05-apar-1: HOTO Na 5 Gida da ginin sa.
t05-01-1: Ioannes. — Baffana, ina son sanin yadda ake gina **gida.**
t05-01-2: Baffa (80) . — Wannan abu ne mai sauƙi ƙwarai, ɗan uwana, zo tare da ni, zan nuna maka wanda malam Bernardus (79) yake sa a gina kuma wanda zan zauna a ciki.
t05-01-3: Ioannes. — Wa ya zana **shirin gini** (76) na wannan gida ?
t05-01-4: Baffa. — **Masanin gini** (75) ; ya gabatar da zane bayyananne ƙwarai wanda aka amince da shi, sai **ɗan kwangila** (77) ya fara aikin.
t05-01-5: Ioannes. — Wane ne kuwa ɗan kwangilar ?
t05-01-6: Baffa. — Shi ne malam Blanko, mahaifin abokinka Iakobus. Yana jagorantar ma’aikata tare da malam Rufo, masanin gini.
t05-01-7: Ga shi ! Malam Blanko yana zuwa a daidai lokaci da **rularsa** (78) , malam Rufo kuma da shirin ginin sa.
t05-01-8: Barka da rana, malamai. Ina lafiya ?
t05-01-9: Malam Rufo. — Lafiya lau, na gode. Barka da rana, Ioannes, kai, yaron nan ya yi girma !
t05-01-10: Baffa. — I, hakika, ƙaramin mutum ne. Yana da natsuwa ƙwarai, dole a sanar da shi kome da ya gani. Yau, yana son ya san yadda ake gina gida.
t05-01-11: Malam Blanko. — To, zo tare da ni, ƙaramin aboki, zan bayyana maka nan take, domin ina son yara masu neman ilimi ƙwarai.
t05-01-12: Ka ga ma’aikacin nan da yake riƙe da **shebur** (82) a hannu : shi ne **mai haƙa ƙasa** (81) . Yana haƙa **rami** (46) domin a sa bututun ruwa. Ya kuma haƙa ƙasar a inda gidan yake, domin magini ya kafa **bangaye** huɗu. Ɓangaren waɗannan bangaye da yake cikin ƙasa ana kiransa **harsashi** (2) . Wurin da yake tsakanin harsashin yana yin **ɗakin ƙasa** (3) . Wannan ɗakin ƙasa yana da ƙaramar taga da ake kira **tagar ɗakin ƙasa** (5) , da **ƙofa** (4) da matakala.
t05-01-13: **Magini** (108) ya ci gaba da gina bangayen yana bar buɗaɗɗun wurare domin **ƙofofi** (8) da **tagogi** (17) .
t05-01-14: Ioannes. — Amma ban ga maginin nan ba !
t05-01-15: Malam Blanko. — Yanzu ya gama aiki a cikin gidan. Yana kusa da **gidan dawaki** (54) , a kan **matakalar aikinsa** (110) , yana gina bangon **wurin wanki** (56) .
t05-01-16: Yana da cokalin magini, da kwanon laka da **ma’aunin tsaye** (109) . Amma ba za ka tuna sunayen nan ba.
t05-01-17: Ioannes. — Lalle zan tuna, domin nan take zan roƙi baffana ƙaramin cokalin magini da ƙaramin kwanon laka, ni kuma da kaina zan yi ma’aunin tsaye da igiya.
t05-01-18: Baffa. — Kai ! madalla. Amma gaya mini, Ioannes, me ake buƙata domin a gina gida ?
t05-01-20: Baffa. — Daidai, ka ga mutumin nan mai babbar hula, a kan **karusarsa** (136) . Shi ne **mai tuƙa karusa** (135) . Kowace rana yana kawo nan **manyan duwatsu** (60) . Yana saukar da kayansa a farfajiya, **masu sassaƙa dutse** (83) kuma suna sassaƙa duwatsun suna kuma yanka su da **zarton dutse** (85) . **Ma’aikacin hannu** (146) yana kai su ga magini wanda yake ajiye su.
t05-01-21: A halin yanzu, **mai gauraya** (87) yana shirya laka. Yana buƙatar **yashi** (62) , da **farar ƙasa** (63) da **ruwa** (64) . Farar ƙasar tana kusa da shi cikin **buhu** (71) , **mai taimakon magini** (111) kuma yana kawo masa yashi a kan **amalanke** (112) , **ɗan koyo** (113) kuwa yana kan famfo (58) . Yana cika **guga** (114) . Ba da daɗewa ba lakar za ta yi. **Mai ɗaukar laka** (107) yana ɗaukarta yana hawa da ita, ta tsani, zuwa kan matakalar aiki, inda magini yake aiki yana gama wannan gefen gidan.
t05-01-22: Yanzu kuma, yaya ake kiran ma’aikacin da yake aikin **rufi** (31) ?
t05-01-24: Malam Blanko. — I, amma da farko sai **masassaƙi** (115) ya zo.
t05-01-25: Masassaƙi yana aikin **katakon rufi** (35) . Yana haɗa **manyan katakai** (37) da **ƙusoshi** (117) . Ma’aikatan nan, can sama, masu fadaɗɗun gajerun wandunan kaɗi, masassaƙa ne. Ɗaya yana riƙe da ƙaramin katako, ɗayan kuma yana yanka ƙusa da **gatarinsa** (116) . Wanda yake kusa da **bututun hayaƙi** (41) shi ne mai rufin gida. Yana ƙusa sandunan rufi a kan (*) katakan bene, da **allunan dutse** (66) a kan sandunan. Wani lokaci yakan sa tayal.
t05-01-26: Rufin gidan dawaki an rufe shi da **tayal** (55) , na gidaje kuwa an rufe su da **allunan dutse** (32) , na baranda kuma da **kwano** (24) .
t05-01-27: Ioannes. — Shin mai rufin gida shi ne yake aikin rufin kwano ma ?
t05-01-28: Malam Blanko. — A’a, sai **mai aikin kwano** (121) ko **mai aikin dalma,** shi ne yake sa **tagar rufi** (38) a kan rufin gidan. Yana sa **bututun ruwa** (43) da **magudanar rufi** (42) ma. Yana walƙa kwano da farar tama. Shi ne ya kafa **sandar tsawa** (40) da **alamar iska** (39) a kan **gaban rufi** (36) .
t05-01-29: Ioannes. — Haka nan gidan ya cika kenan ?
t05-01-30: Malam Blanko. — Bai cika sarai ba. **Mai shafe bango** (99) yana gina bangayen da suke raba shi zuwa ɗakuna iri iri da **bulo** (61) . Yana shafa **farar siminti** (70) a kan **silin** (26) da bangaye. Yanzu yana aikin silin na **baranda** (33) . Yana da, kamar magini, **cokalin magini** (100) da **kwanon laka** (101) .
t05-01-31: Sai kafinta ya yi aikin ƙofofi, da tagogi, da **katakon ƙasa** (16) da **murfin taga** (19) .
t05-01-32: Yanzu yana aiki a farfajiya a kan **teburin aikinsa** (90) . Yana da **zarto** (94) domin ya yanka katako (69) , da **abin santsin katako** (91) , da **mariƙin katako** (92) , da **ƙarfen sassaƙa** (94 bis) , da **kwamfas** (95) , da **gudumar katako** (95 bis) .
t05-01-33: Ioannes. — Kai ! aikin kafinta ya fi na magini daɗi. Baffana, za ka saya mini teburin aiki, da zarto da abin santsin katako, domin ba da daɗewa ba zan yi wa Medor ɗaki.
t05-01-35: Ioannes. — Kai, ina cikin farin ciki ! Wane ne kuma wanda yake tsaye kusa da ƙofar shiga ?
t05-01-36: Malam Blanko. — Shi ne **mai shafa fenti** (102) . Yana tsaye a kan tsaninsa da kwanon **fenti** (103) da **buroshinsa** (104) . Yana shafa katakon ƙofar shiga domin ya daɗe.
t05-01-37: Shi ne kuma yake liƙa takardun bango a cikin ɗakuna.
t05-01-38: **Mai kayan ado na gida** (107) wanda yake kan **tsani** (106) , a kan **barandar sama** (28) , yana sa **labule** (29) .
t05-01-39: Ma’aikacin da yake tsaye kusa da babbar taga shi ne **mai sa gilashi** (96) . Yana kafa **gilashin taga** (18) da **manne** (73) . Ɗayan ma’aikacin, wanda yake durƙushe kusa da ƙofar ɗakin ƙasa, shi ne **mai yin makulli** (97) . Yana sa **makulli** (6) . **Abin nika ƙarfensa** (98) yana kusa da shi.
t05-01-40: Ioannes. — Shin mai yin makulli ne shi ma, ma’aikacin nan da yake bugu da **gudumarsa** (84) a kan ƙarfe ?
t05-01-41: Malam Blanko. — Daidai da gaskiya, maƙeri ne (125) . Yana ƙera **kayan ƙarfe** (67) domin **mai wutar lantarki** (124) wanda yake kan rufin **gidan karusa** (51) . Yana da **maƙera** (126) , da **masaba** (127) da **matsi** (128) .
t05-01-42: Mai wutar lantarki yana kafa **wayar** **jan ƙarfe** (44) ta tarho.
t05-01-43: Baffa. — A ƙarshen **farfajiya** (45) , kusa da **shingen ƙarfe** (47) da **babbar ƙofa** (48) , ka ga **mai lambu** (129) . Yana shirya **ƙaramin lambu** (49) . Ya huda ƙasar da **fartanyarsa** (131) , yana shuka iri yana kuma share da **matsefin lambu** (130) . Sa’an nan, da **abin shayarwarsa** (132) , zai shayar da **gadajen shuka** (50) , tsire-tsire kuwa za su yi girma.
t05-01-44: **Mai kula da doki** (133) wanda ya gama kula da dokin ya kuma ba shi abinci, yana wanke **keken doki** (52) da soso, da **famfon hannu** (134) da guga na ruwa. Sa’an nan zai mayar da shi cikin gidan karusa ya rufe ƙofa da **sakata** (53) mai kauri.
t05-01-45: Ga shi ka gamsu, ina tsammani, ka sami isassun bayanai.
t05-01-46: Ioannes. — I, baffana, amma ina son ganin cikin gidan.
t05-01-47: Baffa. — Wannan zai faru gobe. Malam Rufo zai bayyana maka shirin ginin ya kuma nuna maka sunan kowane ɗaki.
t05-01-48: Masanin gini. — Zo, Ioannes, zan sa ka bincika sassan gidan iri iri nan take.
t05-01-49: Mu shiga **benen ƙasa** (7) . Ga maɓallin **ƙararrawa** (11) . Muna hawan **matakai** (14) uku na **matakalar shiga** (9) , muna ƙetare **bakin** (10) **ƙofar shiga** (8) , ga mu kuwa a gindin **matakala** (13) .
t05-01-50: Ioannes. — Wannan ita ce hanyar wucewa.
t05-01-51: Masanin gini. — A’a, wannan shi ne **ɗakin shiga** (12) . **Hanyar wucewa** (a) tana can ƙarshe. A dama, ga **falo** (b) da **ɗakin cin abinci** (c) , a gaban ɗakin cin abinci kuma akwai **ɗakin girki** (d) da **ɗakin ma’aikata** (e) , sa’an nan a gaba **ɗakin rubutu** (f) . **Baranda** (23) tare da **ƙofarta mai gilashi** (25) tana kusa da falo.
t05-01-52: Nan take za mu hau matakala. Ka riƙe **hannun matakala** (15) ka ƙidaya matakan. Su goma sha huɗu ne. Ga **hanyar sama** (m) , muna kan **bene na farko** (27) .
t05-01-53: A gaban matakala, akwai **bayan gida** (20) da **wurin ado** (j) . A dama akwai kyakkyawan **ɗakin kwana** (g) mai tagogi biyu a **gaban gidan** (1) . A hagu, akwai **ɗakin wanka** (1) da **ɗakin baƙi** (i) tare da babban **ɓoyayyen wurin gado** (h) : kusa da ɗakin kwana akwai **ɗakin yara** (k) . Yana kusa da babban **dandali** (21) . A ƙarƙashin wannan dandali akwai wani bayan gida (20) , a bango kuma, ga **ƙararrawa** (22) wadda take kaɗawa domin abincin dare.
t05-01-55: Masanin gini. — Babu bene na biyu. A ƙarƙashin rufin akwai **ɗakunan rufi** (33) kaɗai da ɗakin ajiyar hatsi (34) . Mun gama bincike, za mu iya sauka.
t05-01-56: Ioannes. — Na gode, malam, wannan yana da ban sha’awa ƙwarai. Nan take zan ba mahaifina labarin kome da na gani.
t06-apar-1: HOTO Na 6 Cikin gida, kayan gida, abinci, haske.
t06-apar-2: Gidan ya cika. Baffan Ioannes ya zauna a sabon gidansa, wanda muka san tsarinsa. Yanzu mu ga yadda ya shirya kayan gidansa. Da farko za mu bincika :
t06-c1-01-1: 1. — Mun iso a lokacin da bai dace ba, domin mai kula da ɗaki tana cikin tsaftace **ɗakin.**
t06-c1-02-1: 2. — A kan **teburin ado** (1) ga kayayyaki iri iri nan da can, waɗanda ake wanke kai da su, ake yin kitso da su, a taƙaice ake yin ado da su. Su ne **kwanon wanka** (2) da **tulun ruwa** (3) , da **buroshin kai** (4) , da **matsefi** (5) , da **sabulu** (6) da **soso** (7) , a ƙarshe kuma **ƙaramar kwalaba** (8) ta maganin haƙori na ruwa.
t06-c1-03-1: 3. — A ƙasa, gaban teburin ado, ga **guga** (9) domin a tara ruwa mai ƙazanta.
t06-c1-04-1: 4. — Muna gani a **ɗakin gaba** (10) waɗansu **ƙugiyoyin tufafi** (13) da **laima** (11) biyu cikin **mariƙin laima** (12) .
t06-c1-05-1: 5. — A ɗaya gefen ƙofar akwai **kabad mai madubi** (14) wanda yake ɗauke da **farar kaya** (15) .
t06-c1-06-1: 6. — Mu yi amfani da lokacin da **mai kula da ɗaki** (16) take shirya **gado** (17) , domin mu bincika sassansa iri iri. **Katakon gado** (20) yana ɗauke da **katifar ƙarfe** (21) mai kyau wadda Iustina za ta ajiye a kanta **katifar ulu** (22) nan take. Sa’an nan za ta ɗauko daga kujeru **zannuwan gado** (23) biyu da **bargo** (24) . Sa’an nan za ta ajiye a kan kan gadon **dogon matashi** (25) da **matashin kai** (26) waɗanda suke tare da **bargon gashi** (27) a kan **tabarmar gado** (32) . Tana amfani da gungun gashin tsuntsu domin ta kakkaɓe ƙura daga **labule** (19) da **rufin gado** (18) , ga wani ɓangaren aikin ya ƙare kenan.
t06-c1-07-1: 7. — Sa’an nan za ta yi gyara kaɗan ga **ƙaramin teburin gado** (28) , ta murza **agogon farkarwa** (29) , ta shirya **ƙaramar fitilar dare** (30) , ta ɗauke **kyandir** (31) domin ta tsaftace mariƙinsa.
t06-c1-08-1: 8. — **Kwandon aikin hannu** (34) kusa da **ƙaramar kujera** (33) shi ma yana buƙatar gyara ƙwarai. Za ta naɗe **ɗinkin ado** (35) , ta sa cikin **teburin ɗinki** (38) **ƙoƙon yatsa,** da **zare** (36) , da **allura** (37) da **almakashi** (39) , ta kuma rufe murfin teburin da **mabuɗi** (40) .
t06-c1-09-1: 9. — A kan **teburin ƙafa ɗaya** (41) na tsakiya, Iustina za ta sabunta ruwan **kwalaban ruwa** (42) . Za ta sa **sukari** cikin **akwatin sukari** (43) , ta tsaftace **matsin sukari** (44) ta kuma ɗauke **buroshin tufafi** (46) .
t06-c1-10-1: 10. — Gefen dama na ɗakin ba zai buƙaci aiki mai yawa ba a gare ta, domin **doguwar kujera** (47) da **matashinta** (48) suna a wurarensu daidai, kuma, tun da ba sanyi ba ne, ba a motsa komai a cikin kayan **murhun bango** (49) . **Shebur** (50) , da **manyan matsi** (51) , da **sandunan wuta** (55) , da **shingen toka** (56) suna da tsabta ; ba a motsa **shingen wuta** (54) ba, **akwatin itace** (52) kuma yana cike da **icen wuta** (53) .
t06-c1-11-1: 11. — Duk da haka za ta kakkaɓe ƙura daga **agogo mai lilo** (57) , da **mariƙan kyandir** (58) da **kwanonin ado** (59) , a ƙarshe kuma ta share **madubi** (60) .
t06-c1-12-1: 12. — Game da **shimfiɗar** (61) jaririn (jariri (*) ), ta riga ta yi shiri.
t06-c2-01-1: 1. — Yanzu ga falo. **Ɗaki** ne mai kyau ƙwarai. Murhun bango, wanda yake a kusurwar dama, an yi masa ado da **ƙaramin mutum-mutumi** (1) mai laushi, da **tuluna** (3) biyu masu kyau, an kuma lulluɓe shi da **lambarkin** (2) na kaɗi (*) .
t06-c2-02-1: 2. — Domin a hana tartsatsin wuta ƙona darduma, an ajiye **shingen tartsatsi** (4) na jan ƙarfe a gaban murhun.
t06-c2-03-1: 3. — A kusa, **teburin rubutu** (5) na mata mai kwarjini yana a buɗe. A kansa **uwar gida** (23) take rubuta wasiƙunta.
t06-c2-04-1: 4. — An yi wa taga ado da **labulen taga** (6) tare da **ɗauransu** (8) da aka rataya a **ƙugiyoyi** (7) da kuma manyan labule na kaɗi **waɗanda aka naɗe a sama** (9) .
t06-c2-05-1: 5. — A cikin ramin taga, **mariƙin tukunya** (11) yana ɗauke da koren **tsiro** (10) , itacen dabino mai kyau wanda ganyensa suke miƙewa kusan har **fitilar kananzir** (12) .
t06-c2-06-1: 6. — **Murfin fitilar** (13) Maria ta shirya shi, **budurwa** (14) mai kwarjini wadda take kan fiyano (15) . A zaune sosai a kan **ƙaramar kujera** (16) , tana nazarin waƙa. Tana da gwaninta da kula ƙwarai, kamar yadda **kabad na waƙarta** (17) yake shaida, wanda aka shirya sarai.
t06-c2-07-1: 7. — Ɗan uwanta, Paulus, yana neman **littafi** (19) a cikin **kabad na littattafai** (18) . **Saurayi** (20) ne, mai motsi kuma marar haƙuri. Yana rataya kansa a kabad ɗin domin ya kai ga littafin da yake can sama, yana cikin haɗarin faɗar da **mutum-mutumi** (21) da yake saman.
t06-c2-08-1: 8. — Yana amfani da lokacin da mahaifiyarsa take hira da wata abokiya, **mata** (22) wadda ta zo ta ɗan yi kwana kaɗan a gidanta, domin ya yi wannan wauta. Mahaifiyar tana zaune a kan **sofa** (24) kusa da **babbar kujera** (25) , abokiyarta kuwa tana kan **kujera** (27) wadda ba a ganin komai daga gare ta sai **madogarar bayanta** (26) .
t06-c2-09-1: 9. — Babban **firam** (30) da yake rataye a bango yana ɗauke da **hoton** (29) wata ƴar uwa. A cikin **littafin hotuna** (32) da aka ajiye a kan tebur an tara **hotunan** (33) sauran ƴan uwan gidan. Yaran sun gama sassaƙe shafukansa yanzu, domin **kujeru** (31) har yanzu suna tare kewaye da teburin.
t06-c2-10-1: 10. — **Tulun ƙasar Sin** (34) na fenti, wanda yake kusa da **wuƙar takarda** (35) , an ba Maria shi a ranar bikinta, **shingen ado** (36) kuwa wanda yake yi wa kusurwar ɗakin ado, baffanta ne ya kawo shi daga ƙasar Sin.
t06-c2-11-1: 11. — Da **zanuka** (37) masu kyau ƙwarai waɗanda aka rataya a **bango** (42) suke faranta shi, da **fitilar rufi** (38) take haskaka shi, wadda **fitilun lantarkinta** (39) suke haske da farin ciki da yamma, wannan falo yana da kyau ƙwarai. Mai laushin **darduma** (40) da aka shimfiɗa a kan katakon ƙasa, da **ƙararrawar lantarki** (41) mai saukin amfani, sun cika jin daɗinsa.
t06-c3-01-1: 1. — Ƙararrawar abincin dare ta kaɗa. Dukan iyalin, sai Maria, sun taru kewaye da tebur. An ɗumama ɗakin cin abinci da kyau da **murhu** (1) na yumɓu mai kyau ƙwarai, mai sirarin **bututu** (2) .
t06-c3-02-1: 2. — Wannan ɗaki ba shi da kayan gida masu yawa. A gefen bango, a saman **ƙaramar kujera** (4) , akwai **ƙaramar marmaron ado** (3) a rataye. Kusa ƙwarai, akwai **kabad na kwanuka** (5) wanda ake ajiye a kansa abincin sanyi, da kwanonin kayan zaki, da kayan tebur iri iri waɗanda ba a buƙatarsu nan take.
t06-c3-03-1: 3. — Haka nan muna gani a kan kantar sama, **gasashshen ɗan kaza** (7) , da **kifi** (8) da **babban kwano** (10) na **ƴaƴan itace** (9) . A ƙasa ga **cuku** (11) , da **burodi** (12) , da **mariƙin kwalabe** (13) wanda yake ɗauke da duk abin da ake buƙata domin a yi wa salatin kayan ƙamshi : mai, da ruwan tsami, da **gishiri** (14) da **barkono** (15) . A ƙarshe, a kan kantar ƙasa akwai **kek** (17) kusa da **mariƙin mastad** (16) .
t06-c3-04-1: 4. — Agogon ɗakin cin abinci, wanda ake kira **agogon bango** (20) , yana da siffa ta musamman ƙwarai. An sa shi cikin firam na katako wanda yake kuma ɗauke da **ma’aunin yanayi** (19) da **ma’aunin zafi** (18) .
t06-c3-05-1: 5. — A dukan bangayen ɗakin an liƙa **katakon bango** (21) mai ƙyalli. **Labulen ƙofa** (22) na kaɗi yana rufe ƙofar da take kai wa baranda sosai. A can ne iyalin za su je su sha kofi bayan abincin dare. Tuni **kofuna** (24) da **farantan kofuna** (25) suke a shirye a kan **teburin kwanuka** (23) .
t06-c3-06-1: 6. — A saman tebur an kafa a silin **fitila mai rataya** (26) wadda fitilarta mai haske ƙwarai take haskaka dukan ɗakin cin abinci da yamma.
t06-c3-07-1: 7. — Yanzu mu bincika **teburin cin abinci** (27) da kansa. Lokacin da iyalin suka shigo, kayan cin abinci sun riga sun shirya. A kan **zanen tebur** (28) an ajiye, a wurin kowane mai ci, **faranti** (33) , da **ɗan tawul** (29) , da **cokali** (34) , da **cokali mai yatsa** (35) , da **wuƙa** (36) da **gilashi** (32) . Akwai kuma **kwalabe** (30) na giya da **kwalaban ruwa** (31) .
t06-c3-08-1: 8. — **Mai hidima** (39) ya fara kawo **kwanon miya** (37) , wanda miya kaɗan take har yanzu tana hayaƙi a ciki. Yanzu yana ba da **kwano** (38) na farko, wato kwanon nama. Sa’an nan zai gabatar da waɗanda muka riga muka ambata, a ƙarshe kuma, bayan **kwanon kayan zaki,** zai yi amfani da lokacin da iyayen gidansa suka shiga baranda, domin ya ɗauke kayan tebur ya kuma sake shirya ɗakin cin abinci.
t06-c3-08-2: *Bayani.* — *An nuna kalmomin da ake amfani da su game da abinci a nan a taƙaice ƙwarai. Za a cika jerin a kan hotuna biyu, « Otal » (na 13) da « Kasuwa » (na 15).*
t06-c4-01-1: 1. — A ɗakin girki, wanda muke kallo ta ƙofar da take rabin buɗe, muna ganin rikici mai ban sha’awa. A gaban **murhu** (1) inda **wuta** (3) take ci da ƙarfi, an kafa **sandar juya nama** (5) . **Gasashshen nama** (7) mai kyau **an tsira shi da sanda** (6) yana dahuwa.
t06-c4-02-1: 2. — **Abin busa wuta** (8) da **shebur na gawayi** (9) , waɗanda aka yi amfani da su yanzu, sun zauna a ƙasa kamar yadda **icen wuta** (10) suka zauna.
t06-c4-03-1: 3. — An shirya saman murhun ; **fitilar hannu** (11) , da **akwatin ashana** (13) , inda **ashana** (12) suke, da **mariƙin kyandir** (14) da **ƙaramin mariƙin kyandir** (15) tare da **kyandir** (16) suna a wurarensu. Amma babbar **gugar gawayi** (18) , cike da **gawayin dutse** (17) wanda **mai girki** (23) ta cika yanzu daga ɗakin ƙasa, ta zauna a tsakiyar ɗakin girkin.
t06-c4-04-1: 4. — Hakika, matar nan mai tausayi dole ta yi gaggawa domin abincin rana ya shirya a kan lokaci. Yanzu tana kusa da **murhun girki** (19) tana juya **miya** (24) wadda bai kamata ta yi ƙona ba.
t06-c4-05-1: 5. — A cikin **tanda** (20) kek yana toyuwa, wanda ta shirya domin ƙaramin abincin yaran. A saman murhun girki akwai **ludayi** (21) da **ludayi mai rami** (22) a rataye.
t06-c4-06-1: 6. — **Kayan girki** (25) , waɗanda aka rataya a ƙarshen ɗakin, suna da tsabta ƙwarai. Kyawawan **tukwane na jan ƙarfe** (26) , da **tulun madara** (27) , da **matata** (28) da **abin nika cuku** (29) an tsaftace su da kula.
t06-c4-07-1: 7. — An ajiye **akwatin gishiri** (30) a kan kabad na kwanuka kusa da **tukunyar shayi** (31) da **babbar kwalaban mai** (32) . Wataƙila **aljihun tebur** (33) yana ɗauke da kayan ci da wuƙaƙen ɗakin girki.
t06-c4-08-1: 8. — **Tsintsiya** (34) da **gungun gashin tsuntsu** (35) suna a kusurwa. Mai girki ta yi amfani da **gungumen katako** (36) yanzu, ta bar shi kusa da taga.
t06-c4-09-1: 9. — **Tawul ɗin hannu** (37) yana rataye a bango, kusa da **mazurari** (38) . A wannan ɓangaren ɗakin girkin an ajiye **gasa** (39) , da **wuƙar yankan nama** (40) da **katakon yankan nama** (41) . Sa’an nan, a saman wuƙar, a kan **kanta** (42) , akwai **tukwane** (43) , da **tukunyar tafasa** (44) tare da **murfinta** (45) da **babbar tukunya** (46) . **Kaskon soya** (47) yana rataye a kusa.
t06-c4-10-1: 10. — **Famfo** (48) na jan ƙarfe kaɗai yake haskakawa a wannan kusurwa. **Wurin wanke kwanuka** (49) , wanda aka ajiye **babban tulu** (50) mai kauri a kansa, wataƙila yana da saukin amfani ƙwarai da ƙaramin kabad ɗinsa, inda ake ajiye **gangar ruwan tsami** (51) tare da **famfonta** (52) , da **akwatin shara** (53) da **faranti masu ƙazanta** (54) .
t06-tit-9: Waɗansu kaya da aka ajiye a ɗakin girki.
t06-c4-11-1: 11. — **Babban kwano** (55) da ake wanke **ganyayyaki** (58) a ciki da **tukunyar ƙarfe** (56) da aka ajiye a kan **ƙasan tayal** (57) wataƙila suna da wurarensu a wannan kabad ma.
t06-c4-12-1: 12. — Lalle mai girki ba ta rasa murhuna, domin ga kuma, a kusurwar tebur, **murhun iskar gas** (59) wanda ruwa yake zafi a kansa cikin ƙaramar tukunya. **Tururi** (60) da yake fitowa daga cikinta yana nuna mana cewa wataƙila tana tafasa. Kila za a yi amfani da wannan ruwa domin kofi, domin ga shi a ɗayan ƙarshen teburin, **tulun kofi** (64) da **niƙar kofi** (63) .
t06-c4-13-1: 13. — An haɗa murhun da **bakin iskar gas** (62) ta wurin doguwar **ƙaramar bututun roba** (61) .
t06-c4-14-1: 14. — **Mai aikin yini** (66) wadda take zuwa ta taimaki mai girki, tana shirya ganyayyaki domin abincin dare. Idan an tsaftace su aka kuma wanke su, za ta sa su cikin **kwano** (65) tana jiran lokacin dahuwarsu.
t06-c5-01-1: 1. — Abu ɗaya kaɗai ya rage mana mu yi na ɓoye domin mu san manyan ɗakunan gidan : mu ga tsarin ɗakin wanka. Wannan ba zai ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo ba, domin ba babba ba ne, kuma za mu san da sauri cewa **kwanon wanka** (1) yana da **abin ɗumama ruwa** (2) mai kyau, cewa **kwanon sabulu** (3) yana inda hannun mai wanka ya isa kuma cewa **mariƙin tawul** (5) lalle zai sa **tawul** (4) su bushe cikin sauƙi.
t06-c5-02-1: 2. — Wannan ɗaki yana da bangayensa a rufe da **tayal** (6) , waɗanda suka ba da damar kafa **shawa** (7) ba tare da tsoron cewa ruwan da yake tashi lokacin amfani da ita zai lalata bangayen ba. **Ƙaramin kwanon ƙarfe** (8) , wanda yake aikin wankan ƙafa, ya cika kayan ɗakin.
t07-c1-01-1: 1. — A hutun sabuwar shekara, na raka mahaifina zuwa Novurbo, ƙaramin ƙauye inda yake buƙatar sasanta waɗansu sha’anin kasuwanci.
t07-c1-02-1: 2. — Mun yi amfani da **babbar karusa** (11) wadda take tafiya tsakanin gari da wannan ƙauye ; amma tun da ana sanyi ƙwarai, wannan tafiya cikin abin hawa marar daɗi bai yi daɗi sosai ba.
t07-c1-03-1: 3. — Shi ya sa muka ji daɗi na gaskiya lokacin da muka ga **mai tuƙi** ya tsayar da abin hawansa a kan filin, gaban **masauki** (2) na *Farin Beyar*. **Mai masauki** (4) yana jiranmu a bakin ƙofar gidansa, yana shan **bututun tabarsa** cikin nutsuwa.
t07-c1-03-2: Ya gayyace mu mu shiga, ni kuwa ban jira a roƙe ni ba sai na zauna gaban wutar rassa da take ci a murhun bango. A lokacin na yi wa **iskar arewa** mai kaifi ba’a ƙwarai, wadda take sa tsohuwar **alamar shago** (3) ta yi ƙara kuma take kwashe **hayaƙin** (1) da yake fita daga bututun cikin baƙaƙen guguwa.
t07-c1-04-1: 4. — Lokacin abincin rana ne. Ba tare da ƙara jira ba, mun ci da kyau abinci mai sauƙi amma mai daɗi da aka yi mana (*) .
t07-c1-05-1: 5. — Bayan abincin rana, na raka mahaifina, wanda yake mai sayar da inshora, zuwa wurin abokan cinikinsa. Da farko mun ziyarci **maƙeri** (5) , wanda yake zaune kusa da masauki. Yana cikin sa wa doki ƙarfe a ƙafa. Na yaba wa ƙarfin abokinsa wanda ya riƙe **kofaton** dokin da ƙarfi a kan afaronsa na fata, alhali maƙerin yana kafa **ƙarfen ƙafa** (6) da bugu masu ƙarfi.
t07-c1-06-1: 6. — Sa’an nan mun je wurin **mai gyaran takalma** (7) na ƙauyen, tsoho Iakobus. Ko da yake yana da **babban takalmi** mai kyau ƙwarai a matsayin alama, ya gamsu da sabunta ƙasan wasu tsofaffin takalma da suka huda.
t07-c1-06-2: Tsohon ya gaya mana yana dariya : « A gari, ni « mai yin takalma » ne kuma ban da abokan ciniki. A nan, ni « mai gyaran takalma » ne, aiki kuwa yana da yawa. »
t07-c1-07-1: 7. — Ya yi mana magana a kan maƙwabcinsa **wanzami** (8) , wanda abokan cinikinsa ba su gamsu da shi ba. **Askarsa** kullum sun karye, **almakashinsa** kuwa ba sa yanka da kyau ko kaɗan. Amma tun da shi ne wanzami ɗaya tak na ƙauyen, ba makawa sai an bar shi ya aske ya kuma yi wa mutum aski. Ban da haka kuma mutum ne mai rowa kuma marar kirki.
t07-c1-08-1: 8. — Da sa’a, sauran **maƙwabta** ba su yi kama da shi ba. Alal misali **mai yin karusa** (9) mutum ne mai kirki, mai himma kuma mai taimako. Jin daɗi ne mutum ya sa shi ya gyara masa abin hawa. Aikinsa kullum yana ƙarewa a kan lokaci.
t07-c1-09-1: 9. — Tsoho Iakobus bai yi gunaguni a kan **mai yin sirdi** (10) ba ma, wanda yakan taimake shi ya ɗinka **kayan doki** idan aikin ya yi yawa.
t07-c1-09-2: Mahaifina ya tambaye shi game da iyalinsa : « Kowa yana lafiya. Jikanyata tana **makaranta** (12) . **Malamarta** (13) ta gamsu da ita ƙwarai, **ɗaliba** (14) ce mai kyau. Ba ta yi kama da ɗana mugun yaro ba ; wasa kaɗai yake tunani. **Malami** (15) bai iya sa shi ya koyi komai ba. »
t07-c1-10-1: 10. — Sa’an nan tsohon ya ba mu labaran ƙauyen. Za a gina sabuwar makaranta, domin wadda take a majalisar gari ta zama ƙarama ƙwarai. Ban da haka wannan abu mai sauƙi ne, domin siyan ɓangaren lambun mai niƙa zai isa. Wannan zai amfani mutumin nan mai tausayi ƙwarai. Saboda sanyi, **duwatsun niƙa** na **gidan niƙa** (16) ba sa iya niƙa alkama kuma, domin **keke** (17) ya tsaya cak saboda **ƙanƙara** (25) ta **ƙaramin kogi** (23) .
t07-c1-11-1: 11. — « Game da gine-gine, shin kun ga sabuwar **cocinmu** (18) ? Tana da ban sha’awa ƙwarai a ƙarƙashin mayafinta na dusar ƙanƙara. **Hankaka** (19) , waɗanda ba su gane tsohuwar hasumiyarsu kuma ba, suna zama cikin baƙin ciki a kan babbar bishiyar **makabarta** (20) . »
t07-c1-12-1: 12. — Wannan tunani game da makabarta ya tunatar da mai gyaran takalma mutanen da mahaifina ya sani kuma suka mutu bara. « Kai, **ƙaburbura** (21) nawa ne, malamina, aka ƙara kan sauran, a ƙarƙashin **dogon icen makabarta** (22) ! Mutuwa ta yanke tsohon magatakardarmu. Dukan mutanen ƙauye sun halarci **jana’izarsa.** »
t07-c1-13-1: 13. — « Ga wanda ya gaje shi yana zamiya a kan ƙaramin kogin. Ya zo yanzu ya sa na gyara masa igiyar **takalman ƙanƙararsa** (26) wadda ta karye. »
t07-c1-14-1: 14. — « Ga kuma a gaɓar ƙaramin kogin, sabon **mai gadin ƙauye** (27) . Tsohon ɗan sanda ne wanda yake tsoratar da ƴan iskan ƙauyen. Suna gudu nan take idan suka hangi **murfin ƙafarsa** (29) da **hular sojansa** (28) . »
t07-c1-15-1: 15. — « Kai ! ga tsoho Iosef yana tuƙa **ƙaramar karusar icen wuta** (30) domin mai gasa burodi. — Gaskiya ne, in ji mahaifina, na gane jarginsa na **alfadarai** (31) . Ina buƙatar yin magana da shi, zan yi amfani da damar. Sai mun sake gani, baba Iakobus. »
t07-c1-16-1: 16. — Daidai lokacin da muka fita, yaran ƙauyen suka bar makaranta suka gaggauta zuwa **wurin zamiya** (33) cikin gudu, cikin haɗarin faɗuwa da karya gaɓa a **faɗuwa** (34) . Ɗaya daga cikinsu ya ɗauko **karusar ƙanƙararsa** (32) wurin mai yin karusa, ya zaunar da ɗaya daga cikin abokansa a cikinta, ya tafi a guje.
t07-c1-17-1: 17. — Waɗansu suka gaggauta zuwa **tudun dusar ƙanƙara** (37) kusa da **gada** (40) suka fara jifan **mutum-mutumin dusar ƙanƙara** (39) da suka kafa jiya kuma da suka sa masa hula da bututun taba da jakar makaranta a kafaɗa.
t07-c1-18-1: 18. — Ba su damu sosai da iska mai sanyi da sanyin ba. Yawancinsu ba su ma da **mayafin wuya** (35) , kuma, domin su sake ɗumama bayan yaƙin **ƙwallon dusar ƙanƙara** (38) , tafin hannu na **kastanya** (42) mai zafi ƙwarai da aka saya wurin tsohuwar **mai sayarwa** Jakobina ya ishe su, ita wadda take rawar jiki saboda sanyi a ƙarƙashin **ƙaramin mayafinta** (43) mai sirara ƙwarai.
t07-c2-01-1: 1. — Duk da dukan jin daɗin hunturu, muna gaisuwar dawowar **bazara** da farin ciki mai zurfi.
t07-c2-01-2: Kai, hoto mai faranta rai ne farfajiyar gona take yi, da yamma, a watan Mayu !
t07-c2-02-1: 2. — A sararin sama **rana** (1) tana faɗuwa a hankali, tana cika **ƙauye** (3) da **haskenta** (2) mai launin jan shunayya. **Manomi mai himma** (6) yana gaggawar nomawa **gonarsa** (4) .
t07-c2-02-2: Da **garmarsa** (5) da aka jarge wa **doki** (7) mai ƙarfi, yana zana **layin noma** (8) inda **mai shuka** (9) zai jefa **iri** da cikakken tafin hannu, irin da zai ba da kan hatsi na zinare.
t07-c2-03-1: 3. — **Masu lauje** (11) da aka ba su laujensu sun yanka ciyawar filin, masu shanya sun bushe **busasshiyar ciyawa** (10) suna juya ta da **sandunan mai yatsa** (12) da matsefi, ga su kuwa suna dawowa.
t07-c2-03-2: Waɗansu suna tafiya gaban abin hawa mai nauyi da shanu suke ja ; suna ɗauke da kayan aikinsu a kafaɗa. Waɗansu, masu ragwanci, sun zauna cikin nutsuwa a kan busasshiyar ciyawa mai ƙamshi.
t07-c2-04-1: 4. — Suna wucewa suna yi wa **mai lambu** (16) gaisuwar abokantaka, shi da yake aiki a **gonar ƴaƴan itace** (13) yana sassaƙa **itatuwan ƴaƴan itace** yana kuma yin gyaran **itatuwan fir** (14) . **Itatuwan furam** (15) suna fara yin fure, kuma, a **gonar ganyayyaki** (17) da aka yi mata taki da kyau, ganyayyaki da kabeji da salati sun riga sun yi kyau.
t07-c2-04-2: A kan ƙaramin bango, **dawisu** (18) mai kyau yana buɗe wutsiyarsa, domin a yaba wa gashinsa masu kyau ƙwarai.
t07-c2-05-1: 5. — Ƙofofin **gidan dawaki** (19) suna a buɗe kuma ana ganin mariƙin ciyawa da **shimfiɗar** (23) **godiya** (21) wadda **mai kula da doki** (20) ya kwance yanzu. **Ɗan doki** (22) mai ban dariya ƙwarai da doguwar ƙafafunsa, yana bin mahaifiyarsa yana tsalle.
t07-c2-06-1: 6. — Kusa da **rijiya** (29) , **shanu** (25) suna zuwa su sha a **kwatarniyar** (26) katako wadda take musu mashayi. **Ɗan sa** (24) yana amfani da damar ya sha nono, **bijimi** (27) kuwa yana jin ƙamshin ciyawa mai kyau, yana yin ruri da farin ciki yana kuma ɗaga kansa mai **ƙahoni** (28) masu ƙarfi cikin alfahari.
t07-c2-07-1: 7. — Kowa yana aiki. **Mai aikin gida** (32) tana riƙe da **igiyar** (31) rijiya da hannu. Tana ɗiban ruwa da **guga** (30) domin ta shayar da dabbobi. Kusa da **rumfar hatsi** (33) , wani mutum yana share ciyawa, a gaban ƙofar **gida** (34) kuwa tsohuwar **mai kaɗi** (35) tana kaɗi da **keken kaɗinta** da **sandarta,** tana kaɗa **lilin** ko **rama** kamar yadda ake yi a zamanin dā.
t07-c2-08-1: 8. — **Manomi** (36) yana jagorantar dukan waɗannan ayyuka yana kuma ba wa ma’aikatansa umarni. Yana ba da shawara a saka **matsefin gona** (40) da **fartanya** (39) a ƙarƙashin rufi, waɗanda aka manta da su kusa da **ɗakin** (38) **kare** (37) .
t07-c2-09-1: 9. — Kiransa yana tsoratar da **tantabara** (41) , wadda take shiga **gidan tantabaru** (42) da dukan fikafikanta, da **kaji** (43) waɗanda suke gaggawar komawa **gidan kaji** (44) .
t07-c2-10-1: 10. — A gaban **gidan tumaki** (48) , ga tsohon **makiyayi** (45) wanda yake mayar da **garkensa** (49) . Yana riƙe da **sandarsa** (46) , wadda ba ta taɓa rasa masa ba, kamar **rigar samansa** (47) da ta koma ba ta da launi, yana kai wa turke **raguna** (50) , da **tumaki** (53) , da **ƴan tumaki** (54) , da **awaki** (51) da **ƴan awaki** (52) . **Karensa** (55) mai aminci Argus ya zo a ƙarshe yana ƙarfafa masu jinkiri da haushinsa.
t07-c2-11-1: 11. — Dukan wannan hayaniya da motsi ba sa dagula natsuwar **saniya mai nono** (56) mai kyau wadda take kaɗa **ƙararrawarta** (57) , alhali ana tatsarta a gaban ƙofar **turke** (58) .
t07-c2-12-1: 12. Ta yi kama da wadda ta gane cewa dole ta ba da nononta, domin **matar manomi** (60) ta iya shirya **man shanu** a cikin **abin kaɗa man shanu** (61) ko kyawawan **cuku** (64) , waɗanda suke ɗiga daga kantar da aka ajiye a kan **babban kwano** (63) .
t07-c2-13-1: 13. — Ana kula da dukan **wurin nono** (59) cikin tsabta ƙwarai ta wurin **ma’aikacin gona** (65) , shi wanda ya wanke **tuluna na nono** (62) yanzu a cikin babbar guga wadda yake ɗauke da ita a hannu.
t07-c2-14-1: 14. — Da takalmansa masu kauri na katako, yana tafiya da ɗan nauyi, haka kuwa yake sa **talotalo** (68) , da **agwagwa mata** (66) , da **agwagwa maza** (67) da **manyan agwagwa** (69) su gudu, waɗanda suke buɗe **bakunansu** (70) sosai suna kuka da fargaba.
t07-c2-14-2: **Zakara** (71) , mai son faɗa, yana ɗaga **jan tsefensa** (72) , yana girgiza gashin **wutsiyarsa** (73) yana kuma yin « kukuruku » mai ƙara.
t07-c2-15-1: 15. — **Kaza mai ƴaƴa** (74) tana yawo a kan **taki** (81) tare da **ƴaƴanta** (75) . **Ɗan alade** (78) yana gudu zuwa wurin mahaifiyarsa, **aladiya** (77) babba wadda muke gani kusa da gidan aladu.
t07-c2-16-1: 16. — A cikin kejinsu, **zomaye** (79) suna cin **ciyawa** (80) mai laushi da ƴar manomi take kawo musu da haɗama. Ioanina tana son zomayenta ƙwarai kuma, kowace rana, bayan ta ɗauko sabbin **ƙwai** (76) a gidan kaji, takan zo ta ziyarci ƙananan abokanta.
t08-apar-1: HOTO Na 8 *Fage na Farko.* Girbi (*) . — Yanayin Ƙauye.
t08-c1-01-1: 1. — Tare da **rani**, yanayin ƙauye ya sake canja. Irin da aka danƙa wa layin noma ya tsira ; ƙaramin tsiro mai ganye ya fito daga ƙasa ya kuma yi kan hatsi. Ƙwaya ta yi, sa’an nan ta nuna, har ma yanzu ba a buƙatar komai sai girbi.
t08-c1-02-1: 2. — **Furannin ƙauye** sun buɗe. **Furen shuɗi** (1) , da **furen ja** (2) da **furen ƙararrawa** (3) suna haɗa wa launi ɗaya na gonakin alkama bambancin **furanninsu** sabbi masu farin ciki.
t08-c1-03-1: 3. — Itatuwan ƴaƴan itace sun yi ado da ganye ; ƴaƴan itacen sun nuna. Ƙaramin **itacen ceri** (4) yana cike da kyawawan **ceri** (5) waɗanda yara suke tsinka suna ci da jin daɗi ƙwarai.
t08-c1-04-1: 4. — Yanzu dabbobi za su iya ci gaba da zama a sararin iska tsawon yini.
t08-c1-04-2: **Ƴan tumaki** (6) sun girma sun zama kyawawan **tumaki** (7) da kyawawan **raguna** (8) masu gashi mai kauri. Suna kiwon **ciyawar** **makiyaya** (9) cikin nutsuwa, makiyayar da **furannin fari** suka yi mata ado.
t08-c1-04-3: Ba da daɗewa ba za a fara aske **waɗannan** dabbobi domin a sami **gashinsu** wanda ake yin kaɗin tufafinmu da shi.
t08-c1-05-1: 5. — **Makiyayi** (10) ya yi kama da wanda bai kula da su sosai ba. Hadarin da yake wucewa a sararin sama kaɗai yake damunsa, **mai kiwon tumaki** (13) kuwa, wanda yake kusanta **salkarsa** (14) da leɓɓansa, ya yi kama da wanda ya fi shi rashin damuwa.
t08-c1-06-1: 6. — Zafi yana matsawa ; domin **kare** (15) ya zo, shi ma, ya kashe ƙishirwarsa ; yana lasar ruwan sanyi na **ƙaramin kogi** (16) yana kuma tsoratar da **ƙaramin kwaɗo** (17) mai tausayi wanda ya ɓoye a cikin ciyawar gaɓa. Shi kuwa ya yi tsalle cikin ruwa mai tsabta inda **furannin ruwa** (18) suke yin fure.
t08-c1-07-1: 7. — **Tsuntsun ruwa** (19) yana yin wanka kusa da **ƙaramar marmaro** (20) wadda take ɓulɓula tsakanin duwatsu biyu, yana kuma ɓoye kansa a ƙarƙashin **ƙayayyuwa** (21) da **ƙayayyuwan fari** (22) .
t08-c1-08-1: 8. — Ga yaran ƙauye, girbin alkama lokaci ne mai daɗi ƙwarai. Suna **birgima** (24) a kan **tudun karan hatsi** (23) da farin ciki, suna taimakon **masu girbi** (26) , kuma alhali waɗannan suna yanka **gonar alkama** (27) da **manyan laujensu** (25) da aka wasa da kyau a kan **dutsen wasa** (30) , su suna tara alkamar suna kuma ɗaure ta a **dammuna** (31) ko **ƙananan dammuna** (32) .
t08-c1-09-1: 9. — Wani lokaci akan yarda wa waɗanda suka fi girma a cikinsu su yanka da **lauje** (12) **kututturan zinare** (28) waɗanda suke ɗauke da **kan hatsi** (29) masu nauyi cike da ƙwaya ; ƙanana kuwa, suna lura da **dabbobi** (33) da suke kiwo a **makiyaya** (34) a ƙarƙashin inuwar babbar **bishiya mai inuwa** (35) , suna kama kyawawan **malam buɗe littafi** da **tarunsu** (36) .
t08-c1-09-2: Har waɗansu suna hawa **karusa** (37) domin su shirya dammunan da ake miƙa musu da **sandar mai yatsa** (38) .
t08-c1-10-1: 10. — A dukan **fili** (39) inda **tsuntsayen sama** (41) suke tashi, ana cikin hargitsi. Kowa yana aikin girbi. Amma, alhali matalauta suna ci gaba da amfani da tsofaffin kayan aiki, wato **lauje, manyan lauje** da **sandunan dako** (40) , masu gonaki masu arziki suna sa a yanka alkamarsu ko **hatsin rai** (43) da **injin yanka** (42) . Sa’an nan, tun da ba a buƙatar kai dammuna zuwa rumfar hatsi, akan yi manyan **tuduna na dammuna** (44) .
t08-c1-11-1: 11. — Sa’an nan akan kawo **injin sussuka** (47) wanda **injin tuƙi** (45) yake motsawa da **igiyar injin** (46) , haka nan kuwa ake raba ƙwaya da **karan hatsi,** ba tare da an bar gonar da aka shuka ta ba.
t08-c1-12-1: 12. — Sau da yawa **manyan hadari** (53) sukan tashi a lokacin girbi. Da farko ana jin cida na **tsawa** daga nesa ; **guguwar yamma** (54) takan fara busawa tana kuma tanƙwara manyan bishiyoyin **daji** (49) tana huci. **Baƙaƙen gajimare** (56) suna kai wa sararin sama hari ; **walƙiya** (55) mai ƙyalli tana ratsa su da karkatattun layi. **Ruwan sama** da wani lokaci **ƙanƙara** sukan fara sauka, suna murƙushe amfanin gonar da yake a shirye a yanka.
t08-c1-13-1: 13. — Sau da yawa walƙiya takan ƙona gini. Haka nan bara rufin **gidan niƙar iska** (50) ya zama toka, biyu kuma daga cikin **manyan fikafikansa** (51) suka farfashe.
t08-c1-14-1: 14. — Bayan sa’o’i kaɗan, natsuwa takan dawo. **Bakan gizo** (52) mai ƙyalli yakan bayyana a sararin sama, halitta kuma takan sake ɗaukar rayuwarta da aka katse na ɗan lokaci. Mutanen ƙauye, waɗanda suka gudu zuwa **bukkoki** (48) , sukan sake yin aiki suna kuma ƙoƙarin gyara barnar da suka sha da ƙarfin hali.
t08-c2-01-1: 1. — A kusan ƙarshen **Agusta** ko tsakiyar **Satumba**, bisa ga yankuna, ana buɗe farauta. Da ƙyar hasken rana na farko ya sa **ƙadangaru** (2) su fito daga ramukansu, sai **mafarauci** (5) ya kama hanya tare da **karnukansa** (4) .
t08-c2-02-1: 2. — Ya sa **kayan farautarsa** (9) masu ƙarfi na kyalle mai kauri, ya sa **murfin ƙafa** na fata a ƙafafunsa, waɗanda za su sa shi ya iya tafiya cikin ciyawa mai ɗanshi inda **kwaɗon ƙasa** (1) suke ɓoyewa ; ya ɗauki **bindigarsa** (6) da **jakar farautarsa** (10) , ga shi kuwa ya tafi.
t08-c2-03-1: 3. — Himmar korar ta kai shi tsakiyar gonar inabi inda girbin inabi yake da ƙarfi ƙwarai. Yaran manomin inabi, waɗanda a kullum suke lura da awaki a kan hanya, yau sun bar su su yi kiwo yadda suka ga dama, kuma bayan sun ɗaure tsohon **bunsuru** (3) a gungume, shi wanda ba zai kasa amfani da ƴancinsa domin ya gudu ba, su ma sun ba wa kansu rabo cikin jin daɗin. Ɗaya ya kama gungun inabi daga **kwandon girbi** (12) yana kuma jin daɗin zuba **ruwansa** (14) cikin **ƙoƙo** (13) domin ya yi ruwan inabi da bai tuya ba. Ɗayan kuwa ya sa **kambin ganye** (15) da ya saƙa yanzu a kansa. Kusa da su, **tsuntsayen gida** (16) marasa kunya suna zuwa har gaban injin matsa inabi domin su saci inabin.
t08-c2-04-1: 4. — Alhali yaran suna nishaɗi, maza suna aiki. **Masu girbin inabi** (18) suna kai inabin cikin ɗakin ƙasa da **kwanduna na baya** (17) ; **mai yin ganga** (19) yana gyara **gangunan giya** (20) , yana duba ko **katakansu** (22) da **ƙasansu** (21) suna cikin kyakkyawan hali, yana kuma musanya **zoban ƙarfe** (23) da suka karye. Shi ne kuma ya yi aikin **manyan kwanuka** (25) da ake zuba **inabi** (26) a cikinsu domin su tuya.
t08-c2-05-1: 5. — Idan tuyar ta ƙare, akan ɗiba giyar akan kuma ajiye saura a kan **injin matsa inabi** (28) , ana matsawa a hankali da **babban sukuru** (29) akan matse ruwan da yake gudana cikin **ƙaramin kwano** (32) , har yanzu kuma ana samun **giyar inabi** (31) .
t08-c2-06-1: 6. — A bangon **ɗakin ƙasa** (27) akwai reshen **ganyen giya** (30) yana hawa. A can tsiro ne na ado kaɗai, amma a waɗansu ƙasashe, inda inabi yake da wuya ƙwarai, ana noma ganyen giya domin a yi **giya.**
t08-c2-07-1: 7. — Ƙaramin **itacen tuffa** (33) yana cike da tuffa waɗanda za su ba da **giyar tuffa** mai kyau ƙwarai idan sun nuna. A cikin **kejinsu** (34) , **kanari** (35) da **tsuntsu mai launuka** (36) suna kallon tsuntsayen gida da suke yawo cikin ƴanci da idon hassada.
t08-c2-08-1: 8. — Har inda ido ya kai, a gefen tuddai, an jera **sandunan inabi** (40) waɗanda suke ɗauke da kyawawan **kututturan inabi** (39) , waɗanda **gungun inabi** masu nauyi suka yi wa ado.
t08-c2-08-2: Tsawon shekara duka, **manomin inabi** (42) ya yi aiki domin ya kula da **gonar inabinsa** (38) , yanzu kuwa an saka masa wahalarsa da girbi mai kyau. **Mata masu girbin inabi** (41) suna cika kwanukan da aka ajiye a kan karusar da **alfadarai** (43) suke ja, kowa kuwa yana cikin farin ciki.
t08-c2-09-1: 9. — Haka nan yake ga **masu kamun kifi da ƙugiya** (44) waɗanda tun da safe suka zo suka zauna a gaɓar ruwa da **sandunan kamun kifinsu** (45) .
t08-c2-09-2: **Kifi** (47) yakan kama **ƙugiya** nan take da suka sa **zarensu** (46) cikin ruwa, kuma da ƙyar suka sami lokacin sabunta **koto,** sai wani sabon wanda aka kama ya yi rawa a ƙarshen zaren.
t08-c2-09-3: Duk da haka **mai taru** (48) , wanda daga **jirgin ruwansa** (49) yake jefa **taru** zuwa tsakiyar **kogi** (50) , yakan kama kifi mafi yawa.
t08-c2-10-1: 10. — Kaka ita ce lokacin yawon shaƙatawa mai kyau : da ƙafa, da **hawan doki** (52) , da **hawan keke** (53) , da **mota** (54) . **Hanyoyi** (51) suna da tsabta ana kuma amfani da kwanaki masu kyau na ƙarshe, domin ga shi tuni **alallaka** (56) suna taruwa a kan rufin gidaje domin su tashi da dukan fikafikansu zuwa ƙasashe masu ɗumi. Ganyayyakin tsohon **itacen wolnat** (57) suna yin rawaya, **wolnat** suna faɗuwa, dogayen **bishiyoyi** kuwa da aka tsara a **gungu** (58) a kan **tudu** (59) ba da daɗewa ba za su rasa ganyensu.
t08-c2-11-1: 11. — **Rana** (60) tana fitowa a makare, kwanaki suna gajarta, ɗan sanyi mai kaifi yana fara jin sa da **safiya,** ga shi kuwa tuni garken **tsuntsayen ƙaura** (61) suna barin ƙasashenmu marasa karɓar baƙi.
t09-c1-01-1: 1. — Kwana takwas ke nan ina Pratz. Ba zan iya bayyana dukan sha’awar da na ji lokacin da nake gaban **duwatsu** (1) masu ban mamaki na Pirenei ba, waɗanda **kansu** (2) yake bayyana a kan shuɗiyar sama kamar babban ado.
t09-c1-02-1: 2. — Ban zata cewa **ƙwanƙolin duwatsu** (3) na Pirenei suna kai wa **tsawo** mai girma haka ba, na kuma yi mamaki ƙwarai gaban kyawawan **duwatsun ƙanƙara** (5) da **ƙwanƙolin dutse** (4) masu dusar ƙanƙara waɗanda **zaftarewar ƙanƙara** mai ban tsoro take gudana a kansu.
t09-c1-03-1: 3. — Tun washegarin isowata, na je tsohon **dutsen wuta** (6) da ya mutu, wanda yake kusa da Pratz. A gaɓoɓinsa busasshe kuma marasa komai na **bakin dutsen wuta,** har yanzu ana ganin alamun wucewar **narkakken dutse** sarai, wanda ya gudana, ƙarnuka da yawa da suka wuce, a kan **gefen dutsen** (7) . Na yi nasarar samun, a kan ɗaya daga cikin **gangarorin,** waɗansu guntayen wannan narkakken dutse.
t09-c1-04-1: 4. — Pratz yana kan iyaka, **kagara** (8) kuwa wadda take kare **mashigin** (27) da yake raba Faransa da Sifaniya, tana tunatar da tsofaffin kagarorin gaɓar Rhine gaba ɗaya, waɗanda suke kama da masu leƙon **ganima** daga saman dutsensu.
t09-c1-05-1: 5. — Babbar **mikiya** (9) wadda take da sheƙarta ba nesa da **kagara** (8) ba, sau da yawa takan ja hankalina. Wannan **tsuntsu mai farauta,** wanda **bakinsa** yake da ƙarfi, sau da yawa yakan kawo wa ƴaƴansa ɗan tunkiya ko ɗan akuya wanda yake riƙe da **faratansa.** Girman **fikafikansa** ya kai ta yadda zai iya shawagi da tsawon lokaci tare da kayansa masu nauyi.
t09-c1-06-1: 6. — A can yawon da ya fi daɗi shi ne tafiya zuwa faɗuwar ruwa (10) ta « Kau ». **Faɗuwar ruwan** tana faɗuwa tana juyawa sa’an nan ta ɓace ta zama kyakkyawan **ƙaramin kogi** a cikin **kurmin itatuwa masu allura** (11) da yake yamma da garin. Mun hau ta wannan kurmi har zuwa **wurin lura da yanayi** (12) , kuma daga saman **wurin kallo,** mun hangi **duk yankin** na wurin. **Yanayin ƙasa** yana da ban mamaki, **halitta** kuwa ta yi kama da wadda take ba wa ƙasar dukan dukiyar da take da ita.
t09-c1-07-1: 7. — Domin mu sauka, mun yi amfani da **keken igiya** (13) , mun kuma tsaya a ƙaramar **tasha** kusa da **kufan** (14) tsohuwar **kagara** wadda sarakunan Pratz suka zauna a ciki a dā.
t09-c1-08-1: 8. — Kagara mai tausayi ! Me take tunani kuwa tana ganin a ƙasa **garin ruwan magani** (15) mai kwarjini wanda yanzu ya zama **tashar ruwan zafi** ta zamani ?
t09-c1-08-2: **Yanayi** yana da daɗi ƙwarai, **ruwan ma’adinai** kuwa yana da amfani ƙwarai, har **maganin** da ake yi a **asibitin hutu** (17) jin daɗi ne na gaskiya.
t09-c1-09-1: 9. — Ban da haka, an yi kome domin zaman ya yi daɗi. An gina babbar **gadar jirgi** (16) domin a sami hanyar jirgin ƙasa ; an shirya **gonar shaƙatawa** (18) ta **gidan wanka na magani,** inda ake **kiɗa,** ta hanya mai kwarjini. An gina « **gidajen hutu** » (19) masu kyau da yawa kewaye da gidan caca (21) , **babbar hanya** (22) kuwa da ake kula da ita sosai tana sauƙaƙa sadarwa ƙwarai.
t09-c1-10-1: 10. — **Gangaren ƙasa** (23) kawai yake raba **hanya** (20) da **kwari** (25) na gaskiya, wanda a ƙarshensa akwai kyakkyawan ƙaramin **tafki** (26) wanda yake ciyar da **ƙaramin rafi** (24) mai tsabta.
t09-c1-11-1: 11. — A ɗaya gefen kwarin, ana aikin **ma’adinan ƙarfe** (28) . Sau da yawa na je na ga **ma’aikatan ma’adinai** suna sauka cikin **rami,** har ma na shiga **hanyar ƙasa** inda suke ciyar da yininsu, suna fito da **ma’adini** wanda yake ɗauke da **ƙarfe.**
t09-c1-12-1: 12. — An gina babban **wurin narkar da ƙarfe** kusa da ma’adinan domin a yi amfani da dukiyar da ake fito da ita nan take. **Babbar tanda** (29) , wadda ake ɗumama ta da **gawayin dutse** wanda yake da yawa a nan, tana ba da damar samun **narkakken ƙarfe** da sauri kuma da arha.
t09-c1-13-1: 13. — Ba nesa da ma’adinan ba ana haƙa **ma’adinan dutse** (30) . Ba **dutsen granit,** ba **dutsen forfir,** ba ma **dutsen yashi** tsohon **mai haƙar dutse** yake yankewa da **gatarin dutsensa,** sai **sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu** kaɗai domin ginin gidaje.
t09-c1-14-1: 14. — Ɗaya daga cikin kyawawan adon wannan ƙasa shi ne **itatuwa masu allura** (31) . Ko’ina a ƙarshen **kwazazzabo** (32) , a gaɓar **gudun ruwa** (33) , ko **rami mai zurfi** (34) ko gaci, sirarun allurarsu suna ba da inuwar kore.
