t09-c1-15-1: 15. — Ina amfani da hutuna domin **doguwar** tafiya. **Hanyoyi** (35) da suke karkata a kan dutsen suna ba da damar tafiya, ba tare da lura da nisa ba, **kilomita** da yawa kuma sau da yawa **kilomita huɗu-huɗu** da yawa.
t09-c1-15-2: **Iyakoki** (36) da **sandunan nuni** (37) suna nuna hanyoyin, inda sau da yawa mutum yakan haɗu da matashin **ɗan dutse** (38) da **jaka mai kai biyu** (40) a gefensa, yana ɗauke da **ɓeran dutse** (39) , ko wani **ɗan yawo** (41) wanda **gajeriyar rigarsa** (42) take yin bambanci mai ban mamaki da tsohuwar **hular kansa** (43) da ta yage. Yana jan **beyar** (44) da aka hora da sarƙa.
t09-c1-16-1: 16. — Kusan kowace rana ina tafiya tare da **jagora** (48) domin in yi **hawan dutse,** ina kuma alfahari ƙwarai idan, da **jaka** (47) a baya da « **sandar hawa** » a hannu, kamar **matafiyi** (46) na gaskiya, na kai wa **duwatsu** (45) hari.
t09-c1-17-1: 17. — Daga saman dutse, mazaunan fili suna kama da waɗanda ba su fi tururuwa girma ba ; **garken tumaki** (50) yana kiwo a **makiyaya** (49) ya yi kama da abin wasan yara. **Itacen ɗanko** (51) ko kuma **ƙaramin gidan katako** (52) yana kama da ɗigo kaɗai a kan kore.
t09-c1-18-1: 18. — A lokacin waɗannan tafiye-tafiye, sau da yawa mukan haɗu a kan **ƙaramar hanya** (53) da **mafarautan akuyar dutse** (54) yana ɗauke da dabbar da ya kashe yanzu a kafaɗa.
t09-c1-19-1: 19. — Na ajiye a littafin ganyayena reshen **ganyen zare** (55) mai ban sha’awa ƙwarai da kyakkyawan ƙaramin reshe mai launin hoda na **furen tudu** (57) waɗanda na tsinka a bakin ƙaramin **kogo** (56) a tafiyata ta ƙarshe.
t09-c2-01-1: 1. — Jiya na yi rana mai daɗi ƙwarai a cikin kurmi. Himmar da take tsakanin dabbobi da **ƙwari** (5) da suke zaune a ciki ta ba ni sha’awa ƙwarai.
t09-c2-01-2: **Gizo-gizo** (1) wanda yake saƙa **yanarsa** (2) tsakanin rassa biyu domin ya kama **ƙuda** (3) mai wucewa, **katantanwa** (4) tana ɗauke da ƙwaryarta da wahala, ƙwaro mai ƙaho yana bincike a kan abin da ya kama, tururuwa mai himma tana ƙwazo kusa da **gidan tururuwa** (6) , dukan waɗannan ƙanana sun tafi, sun zo, sun yi aiki da himma ta musamman.
t09-c2-02-1: 2. — **Maciji** (7) wanda da farko na zata **kububuwa,** amma wanda ba wani abu ba ne sai **maciji marar dafi** kaɗai, ya ɓoye a ƙarƙashin kututturen bishiya, lokaci zuwa lokaci kuma yakan fito da ƙaramin kansa mai sirara wanda kullum ya yi kama da mai shirin cizo. A gabana **babbar katantanwa** (8) tana rarrafe da nauyi bayan ta cinye ɗaya daga cikin **ƴaƴan sitiroberi** (11) masu daɗi da suke girma da yawa a can.
t09-c2-03-1: 3. — An shimfiɗa ƙasar da **furannin kurmi** ; **furannin farko** (9) , da **furen shuɗin daji** (10) , da waɗansu tsire-tsire da yawa da ban sani ba, suna yin fure tsakanin **kunkuman ciyawa** (12) .
t09-c2-04-1: 4. — A wannan yanki, **naman kaza na ƙasa** kusan yana da yawa kamar **naman kaza** (14) , kuma **ɗan alade** (13) na wani mai gadin daji, yana bincike da haɗama ko zai yi nasarar samun waɗansu daga cikinsu.
t09-c2-05-1: 5. — Na halarci **ƙarshen** wani fage da ya ba ni daɗi ƙwarai. Da taimakon sunsunar **ƙaramin karen farautarsa** (15) , **mai gadin daji** (16) ya kama **ɗan farautar sata** (22) bisa ba zato ba tsammani, a daidai lokacin da wannan yake shirin ɗaukar **naman daji** (17) da ya kashe. Domin ya fi son ya bar abin da ya kama da a kama shi, ɗan farautar satan ya gudu, **zomon daji** (18) , da **barewa** (19) , da **ƙaramar barewa** (20) da **aladen daji** (21) kuwa suka kwanta a kan ciyawa suna faranta wa mai gadin daji rai.
t09-c2-06-1: 6. — Bambancin itatuwan da kurmi yake ɗauke da su yana da ban mamaki. **Itatuwa masu santsin ɓawo** (23) da **itatuwa masu farin ɓawo** (26) , da **itatuwa masu ɗanko,** waɗanda suke ba da **ɗanko** (27) , da **itatuwan oak** (29) da kuma waɗansu da yawa suna haɗa rassansu.
t09-c2-06-2: **Ciyawar hawa** (24) , wadda take manne da kututturen dogayen itatuwa, tana ba wa **kurmi** (25) launin kore mai ƙyalli, wanda yake haɗuwa da daɗi da launin kore mai haske na **gansakuka** (31) inda **tsuntsun ƙwanƙwasa itace** (30) yake neman ƙwari.
t09-c2-07-1: 7. — Tsofaffin itatuwan oak sun ba ni sha’awa. Manyan **saiwoyinsu** (32) da suka murɗe, rabin fitowa daga ƙasa, suna ba su kyakkyawan kamannin ƙarfi da ƙwari, ina kuma tambayar kaina yadda **mai gonar** (35) zai iya yarda a sassare su a kai su ga **zarton** (34) **mai sara** (33) . **Kututture** (36) masu tausayi, da aka tuɓe **ɓawonsu** (37) ko da **gatarin** (38) **ɗan ƙwadago** (39) ya tsage su, suna ɓata mini rai.
t09-c2-08-1: 8. — A kusa, tsoho **mai yin gawayi** (41) ya shirya da **shebur ɗinsa tudun** (42) gawayi, tsohuwa kuwa ta ɗauko **ɗamin** (40) **busasshen itace** na rassan itatuwan da aka sassare.
t09-c2-09-1: 9. — Na so in je in huta na ɗan lokaci a **gidan mai gadin daji** (46) amma, lokacin da na iso kusa da **ƙaramin tafki** (43) , inda kyakkyawar **farin agwagwa mai doguwar wuya** (45) take iyo, sai na lura cewa **ambaliya** (44) ta baya-bayan nan ta canja hanyar ta zama **fadama** ta gaskiya. Sai na juya, kuma, ina wucewa kusa da **itacen ƙamshi** (49) , da **sirarun bishiyoyi** (48) da **itacen laima** (47) da suke a bakin kurmin, sai na ga daga **sarƙaƙƙiya** (54) **namijin barewa** (50) mai kyau yana fitowa, **karnukan farauta** (51) masu taurin kai suna korarsa, waɗanda **ƙahon** (53) **mafarauta a kan dawakai** (52) ya ƙarfafa su. Dabbar mai tausayi ta gaji gaba ɗaya. Ta zo ta faɗi tana mutuwa ƴan taku kusa da ni.
t09-c2-10-1: 10. — Ɗan mai gadin daji, wanda hayaniyar **farautar gudu** ta jawo shi, ya fito daga gidan mu kuma mu biyu muka koma cikin kurmin. Ya ga **tsuntsu mai baƙi da fari** (56) a kan reshen tsohon itacen oak. Ya zaci cewa wataƙila an ɓoye sheƙarsa cikin **ganyaye** (58) , ya kuma so ya kama sheƙar.
t09-c2-10-2: Mai saurin motsi kamar **kurege** (61) , ya hau daga **reshe** (55) zuwa reshe, amma bai sami komai ba ya kuma yi nasarar tashi da tsohuwar **hankaka** (60) kaɗai wadda take zaune a kan **ƙaton reshe** (57) .
t10-apar-1: HOTO Na 10 Teku. — Tashar jiragen ruwa.
t10-01-1: 1. — A lokacin rani, alhali waɗansu suna neman natsuwa da sanyi a kan dutse, waɗansu sun fi son zuwa gaɓar teku. Haka muka yi bara, domin muna son **Babban Teku** (1) ƙwarai.
t10-02-1: 2. — Game da ni, ina jin daɗi ƙwarai ina kallon wannan faɗin ruwa mai girma wanda yake miƙewa har **iyakar ido** (2) , ina kuma ganin **manyan jiragen ruwa masu tururi** (3) suna tashi domin doguwar **tafiya,** jiragen da matafiya masu zuwa Amirka suke hawa.
t10-03-1: 3. — Shi ya sa mahaifina, wanda ya san abin da nake so, kullum yakan zaɓi, domin mu yi hutu, wani bakin teku mai natsuwa ƙwarai, wanda yake kusa da ɗaya daga cikin manyan **tashoshin jiragen ruwa na yaƙinmu.**
t10-03-2: A zamanmu na ƙarshe, **rundunar jiragen ruwa** ta zo ta kafa anka a bayan babbar **katangar ruwa** (4) wadda take rufe kuma take kare **tashar jiragen ruwa ta yaƙi** (5) , na kuma yi nasarar yaba wa **jiragen ruwan yaƙi** iri iri kamar yadda nake so, wato ƙaramin **jirgin ruwa mai nutsewa** (10) wanda yake nutsewa ya ɓace a ƙarƙashin ruwa da kuma babban **jirgin ruwa mai sulke** (9) wanda, har yanzu, kusan harin **jirgin ruwan turfido** (8) kaɗai yake tsoro.
t10-04-1: 4. — Wannan ya riga ya san yadda zai sami wurin da ya raunana na sulken ƙarfe mai kauri **cikin gwaninta,** domin ya kafa a can **turfido** mai haɗari, wanda fashewarsa take sa jirgin ya nutse, amma duk da haka ba a jin tsoronsa kamar jirgin ruwa mai nutsewa, domin jiragen hana turfido suna iya korarsa cikin sauƙi.
t10-05-1: 5. — Na kuma iya ganin **jiragen sintiri** (6) masu sauri da aka yi wa sulke, waɗanda kusan ba a iya ji musu ciwo kamar jirgin ruwa mai sulke na gaskiya, da **jiragen ɗaukar kaya** (12) da yawa, da **jiragen igwa** (7) uku ko huɗu, a ƙarshe kuma **faragat** (11) ɗaya. **Kallon wannan rundunar jiragen ruwa, idan take motsi domin ta ɗauke anka, shi ne mafi ban sha’awa.**
t10-06-1: 6. — Kai, bambancin gini nawa ne tsakanin waɗannan manyan tuddan ƙarfe da kyawawan **jiragen mastu uku** ko **jiragen ruwa masu zanen iska** (13) masu kwarjini waɗanda har yanzu ake amfani da su a rundunar kasuwanci, waɗanda na gan su suna shiga tashar, da dukan zanen iskarsu, lokacin da nake yawo a kan **gaɓar tashar** (14) . Hakika waɗannan sun rasa amfaninsu da yawa **lokacin** da **iska** ta zama ta gaba. Dole su saukar da dukan zanen iska domin su sake shiga tashar, **jirgin jan wasu** (16) kuwa ya zama dole domin ya ɗauke su ya kai su, kamar **jiragen kaya** (17) kawai, zuwa tashar ruwa.
t10-07-1: 7. — Abin da yake ba da sha’awa a tashar da nake magana a kanta shi ne cewa ba tashar yaƙi kaɗai take ɗauke da ita ba, wadda aka shirya da hannu da ayyuka masu girma, sai dai kuma **tashar kasuwanci** mai ban mamaki wadda take a **bakin** babban kogi.
t10-08-1: 8. — Harshen ƙasar da yake raba tashoshi biyun an yi masa kagara ana kuma kare shi da jerin **wuraren igwa** da **hasumiyoyin yaƙi** waɗanda suke miƙewa a kan teku. Ana buƙatar izini na musamman domin a yi yawo a kan **katangar yaƙi** (15) . Na sami shi cikin sauƙi, ta wurin baffana, wanda yake injiniyan **wuraren gina jiragen ruwa** (18) , na kuma je na ziyarci jiragen da ake gina a ƙarƙashin manyan rumfuna.
t10-09-1: 9. — Har na halarci saukar da jirgin ruwa mai sulke a ruwa, ina kuma tuna lokacin motsin rai da dukan taron suka ji sa’ad da katon abin nan, da aka bar shi ga kansa, ya fara zamiya a kan katakon da yake riƙe da shi ya kuma zo ya yi iyo a kan ruwan kogin.
t10-10-1: 10. — Domin a je wuraren gina jiragen ruwa, akan ƙetare **filin atisaye** (19) inda sojojin sansanin suke zuwa horo kowace rana, akan wuce a kan **ƙaramar gada** (20) ta ƙarfe, wadda take haɗa filin faretin da **ma’ajin makamai** (21) .
t10-11-1: 11. — Tare da baffana, na ziyarci wannan babban gini cike da **igwaye** (22) , da **harsasan igwa** (23) da **bama-bamai.** Na kuma ga **wurin narkar da ƙarfe** (24) inda ake yin **manyan tukwanen tururi** (25) na jiragen ruwa masu tururi.
t10-12-1: 12. — A kusa ƙwarai, akwai **wuraren gyaran jiragen ruwa** (26) da **wurin gyara mai iyo** (27) mai ban mamaki ƙwarai, inda na iya gani a kusa ƙwarai, a kan jirgin da za a gyara, **fankar** (28) , da **ƙasan jirgin** (29) da **linzamin** (30) jirgin.
t10-13-1: 13. — Tashar kasuwanci tana da daraja a yi nazarinta kamar tashar yaƙi, na kuma yi sa’o’i da yawa ina kallo a kan tashoshin ruwa inda aka ɗaure **jiragen ruwa masu keke** (31) waɗanda suke hawan kogin, ina kuma kallon **manyan injinan ɗagawa** (32) suna aiki, waɗanda suke ɗaga manyan kaya kamar gashin tsuntsu.
t10-14-1: 14. — Na yaba wa **jiragen tsallaka teku** (34) suna fita daga mashigin, da **tutocinsu** (35) cikin iska, **matuƙin jirgin ruwa** (36) gwani yake jagorantarsu, shi wanda ya iya bin **hanyar ruwa** da aka yi mata alama da **alamun ruwa** (40) da sandunan nuni cikin gwaninta, yana guje wa **jiragen kaya masu zanen iska** (41) waɗanda ake tuƙa su da wahala da zanen iskarsu guda ɗaya mai kusurwa huɗu. Na rarrabe a **gaban jirgin** (37) — hancin jirgi — **ɗakunan** (39) na aji na biyu, kuma a **bayan jirgin** (38) — wutsiyar jirgi — falo domin matafiya na aji na farko.
t10-15-1: 15. — Wani lokaci na kuma halarci ɗora kaya a kan **jirgin kaya** (42) inda aka tara kayayyakin **ma’aji** (43) da na **tashar teku** (44) yanzu, waɗanda jiragen ƙasa masu yawa na **layin dogo na tashar** (45) suka kawo.
t10-16-1: 16. — Sau da yawa na yi tuƙi a **tashar jiragen ƙanana** (53) , inda **ƙananan jiragen ruwa** (46) suke zuwa su huta, kuma jin daɗi ne a gare ni in motsa **sandar tuƙi** (47) . Na hau **benen jirgi** (48) na **ƙaramin jirgi mai zanen iska** (49) , na hau, ta wurin **manyan igiyoyi** (52) , a kan **mastu** (51) zuwa **sandunan zane** (50) , sa’an nan na sake yawona **da ƙaramin jirgi** (54) tsakanin **jiragen kamun kifi** (55) masu nauyi, inda **taruna** (56) suke bushewa.
t10-17-1: 17. — A kan **tashar ruwa** (58) , **kayayyaki** (59) iri iri sun wuce a gabana, waɗanda suke cikin **akwatuna** (60) ko cikin **manyan ɗamummuka** (61) . Sun yi **kayan** (63) manyan jiragen kaya, **injinan ɗagawa** (62) masu ƙarfi kuwa suka ɗauke su suka ajiye su a kan **manyan motoci** (64) alhali **masu jigilar kaya** suka bayyana su suka kuma biya haraji a **ofishin kwastan** (65) .
t10-18-1: 18. — A ƙarshe, lokacin da na iso **gada mai juyawa** (66) ko **ƙofar ruwa** (69) , ina wucewa gaban **injin tsintar ƙasa** (68) wanda yake tsaftace **magudanar ruwa** (67) , sai na sauka a gaɓar tashar kusa da **alamar jiragen ruwa** (70) .
t10-19-1: 19. — A ɗaya gefen wannan gaɓa ne **ƙananan jiragen sojoji** (71) suke zuwa su sauka, waɗanda suke kai jami’an rundunar ƙasa. Abin sha’awa ne mutum ya ga matuƙan jirgin ruwa suna ɗaga sandunan tuƙinsu cikin kari, alhali jirgin da **raƙumin ruwa** (72) yake ɗauke da shi yake sauka a matakalar wurin sauka cikin sauƙi. A wannan wuri, mutum yakan iya lura da **gudun teku** da motsin **hawan teku** da **jan bayansa** a kan **bakin teku** (73) da kyau.
t10-20-1: 20. — Domin in komo gida, na yi amfani da **tiram na lantarki** (74) wanda **tashar sa** (75) take kusa da **gungumen** da aka ajiye gaban ƙungiyar jami’ai.
t10-20-2: Daga kan **barandar sama** (76) ta ƙungiyar, wadda aka yi wa ado da **ankoki** (77) da igwaye da harsasan igwa, sau da yawa na ga taron jami’an ruwa masu kwarjini : **laftanoni** (78) , da takobinsu, da **kyaftinonin igwa** (79) da **na sojojin ƙasa** (80) da **takobinsu mai lanƙwasa.** A bayansu akwai **matuƙin jirgin ruwa** (81) wanda yake kawo musu **madubin gani mai nisa,** idan suna son su rarrabe abin da yake faruwa can nesa.
t10-21-1: 21. — Na kuma ga matasan **ƙananan laftanoni** (82) suna karɓar umarnin **kwamandansu** (83) ko na **admiral** (84) , alhali **sajan jirgin ruwa** (85) yake jira domin ya kai su ga jirgin.
t10-22-1: 22. — Daga wannan baranda, kallon yana da kyau ƙwarai : mutum yana hango dukan bakin teku da **tantinsa** (86) da **ƙananan ɗakunansa** (87) , mutum kuma yana gani, a lokacin wanka, **masu wanka** (88) suna yin wasa da farin ciki gaban **gidan caca** (89) .
t10-23-1: 23. — A ƙarshen bakin teku, gaɓar tana yin ƙaramin **hancin ƙasa** (91) **mai duwatsu,** inda **manyan raƙuman ruwa** (92) suke zuwa su karye kuma inda aka gina **fitilar teku** (93) , wadda take nuna hanya ga matuƙan jirgi da dare. Wannan hancin ƙasa yana haɗuwa da ƙasar ta **matsattsiyar hanyar ƙasa** kaɗai (90) .
t10-24-1: 24. — **Gaci mai tsawo** (94) yana miƙewa, teku ya tsaga shi, teku wanda yake zana a cikinsa jerin **mashiga** (95) da **hancin ƙasa** yadda ya ga dama, yana sa shi ya zama mai ban sha’awa ƙwarai.
t10-24-2: A kan **tudun fili** (96) , wanda yake hangen **mashigin teku** (98) , akwai **kagara** (97) mai muhimmanci ƙwarai da waɗansu « gidajen hutu ».
t10-25-1: 25. — Wannan mashigi yana raba da nahiya **tsibiri** (99) mai haɗari ƙwarai, wanda **duwatsun ruwa** (100) da wuraren karyewar raƙuma suka kewaye shi, inda ƙananan jiragen ruwa har ma manyan jiragen ruwa sukan kafe wani lokaci. Duk da shirin taimako, da saurin isowar **jiragen ceto,** **nutsewar jiragen ruwan** nan tana da ban tsoro, kuma, a lokacin **guguwa** ta daidaita rana da dare, jiragen ruwa da yawa sun hallaka tare da mutane da kaya.
t10-25-2: Duk da wannan makwabtaka, **tashar jiragen ruwa** tana da yawan matuƙan jirgin ruwa ƙwarai.
t11-apar-1: JERI NA UKU HOTO Na 11 Gari da gine-ginensa. — Gobara.
t11-c1-01-1: 1. — Ina zaune a wani babban gari da yake kilomita 100 daga Babban Teku, wanda duk da haka yake **tashar jiragen ruwa** (1) ta matsayi mai girma. Kogin da yake iyakance shi yana da faɗin mita 400 kuma yana yin kyakkyawan mashigi.
t11-c1-02-1: 2. — Dukan ɓangaren garin da yake kan **tashoshin ruwa** (2) yana da kamannin teku da masana’antu gaba ɗaya, yana kuma yin **unguwar bayan gari** (3) wadda matuƙan jirgin ruwa da ma’aikata kaɗai suke zaune a ciki. Waɗannan suna aiki a **masana’antu** (4) da **gidan iskar gas** (5) wanda ake ganin doguwar **bututun hayaƙinsa** (6) da **ma’aunin gas** daga nesa ƙwarai.
t11-c1-03-1: 3. — A tsakiyar zamanai, an yi wa garin ganuwa, har yanzu kuwa akan sami waɗansu saurar ganuwarsa, musamman **ƙofar gari** (8) ta tsohuwar **kagara** (7) wadda **hasumiyoyinta** (9) biyu suke gefenta, waɗanda yanzu ake amfani da su a matsayin **kurkuku.**
t11-c1-04-1: 4. — A dukan wannan **unguwa,** wadda take da kamannin tsufa ƙwarai, gini ɗaya kaɗai yake na zamani : shi ne **gidan kwastan** (10) . Yana tsakanin tashar ruwa da **ƙaramar hanya** (11) wadda take kai wa tsohuwar **majalisar gari** (12) . Ana gane wannan gini na ƙarshe cikin sauƙi saboda babbar **hasumiyar ƙararrawa** (13) wadda take hangen tsohon garin.
t11-c1-05-1: 5. — A ɗaya gefen hanyar, akwai gini **a tsaye** da aka gina da salo ɗaya da gidan kwastan : shi ne **Kasuwar hannun jari** (14) . Ɗaya daga cikin fuskokinsa yana fuskantar ƙaramin fili inda **gidan gwamna** (15) yake. Hakika, garinmu, ba tare da ya zama babban birni ba, duk da haka babban birnin lardi ne mai muhimmanci.
t11-tit-2: Ɓangaren Gari da Ya Fi Tsawo.
t11-c1-06-1: 6. — Sansanin sojoji, mai yawa sosai, yana zaune a manyan **barikin sojoji** (16) masu lafiya ƙwarai ; suna miƙewa har shingen **gonar shaƙatawa ta gari** (17) . **Babbar hanya** (19) wadda take kai wa wannan gona tana wucewa a bayan **bankin tanadi** (18) tana kuma kai wa filin **babban coci** (20) .
t11-c1-07-1: 7. — Dukan waɗannan gine-gine suna miƙewa a kan ƙaramin tudu kamar matakai, inda babbar **makarantar sakandarenmu** (21) take ma.
t11-c1-07-2: Idan mutum ya sauka ta wata hanya mai ɗan gangara, wadda take haɗuwa da Babbar Hanya, sai ya iso **Kotu** (22) wadda **lambun jama’a** (26) mai daɗi yake miƙewa a gabanta. Wannan **filin lambu** ba babba ba ne ƙwarai, amma yana yin marmaro na kore da sanyi a tsakiyar gari. Shi ya sa mutanen gari suke zuwa gare shi da yawa, waɗanda suke son zuwa su zauna a ƙarƙashin tantin **gidan kofi** (25) , domin su saurari makaɗan sojoji waɗanda ranar Alhamis da ranar Lahadi suke kaɗawa a **rumfa** (27) da aka ajiye tsakanin filayen ciyawa da tsire-tsire.
t11-c1-08-1: 8. — A kan ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan filayen ciyawa akwai **mutum-mutumi** (28) na tagulla a tsaye, abin tunawa da aka kafa domin tunawa da ɗaya daga cikin ƴan garinmu, wanda ya yi wa garin haihuwarsa manyan hidimomi.
t11-c1-09-1: 9. — Har yanzu ba a haskaka garinmu da hasken lantarki ba, yana da **fitilun gas** (29) kaɗai. Amma **jaridun nan** suna gwagwarmaya domin a inganta wannan tsarin haskakawa, **kamar** yadda aka riga aka inganta **tsarin jan tiram.** An maye gurbin **tsofaffin** **kekunan doki** da **tiram na lantarki** (31) a aikace, waɗanda suke jigilar matafiya da sauri daga ɗaya **ƙarshen gari zuwa ɗaya,** a kan farashi **mai arha** ƙwarai.
t11-c1-10-1: 10. — Kusa da Gidan Shari’a akwai **Banki** (32) inda ake sayen takardun kasuwanci. **Wakilan banki** (33) suna zuwa su karɓi bashi a gidajen mutane.
t11-c1-11-1: 11. — Kyakkyawan ginin da yake tsaye a kusa shi ne **gidan kayan tarihi.** Yana ɗauke tare da **ɗakin karatu** (34) na garin, da kyawawan **tarin ilimin halitta** (35) da kuma **gidan tarin zanuka** (36) mai kwarjini wanda yake yin **wurin baje koli** na dindindin mai kyau.
t11-c1-11-2: Ana buɗe shi ga jama’a sau biyu a kowane mako, amma baƙi suna iya ziyartarsa kowace rana idan sun ba **mai gadi** (37) ɗan kyauta. **Masu zane** (38) suna zuwa can domin su yi aiki. Muna ganin su **gaban** kayan zanensu, da allon fenti a hannu, suna kwafin shahararrun zanuka.
t11-c1-12-1: 12. — A kan tudu, a bayan gidan kayan tarihi, mun fara ganin **rumfar rufi** (40) ta **asibiti** (39) da gine-ginen **makarantar horar da malamai** (41) inda aka horar da malaman makarantunmu na gari. A kan filin Gidan Wasan Kwaikwayo akwai **gidan waya** (43) da aka kafa a cikin **gidan mutum** (42) .
t11-c2-01-1: 1. — Labari mai ban tsoro ya bazu cikin garin : gobara ta tashi a gidan wasan kwaikwayo yanzu ! A daidai lokacin da na iso **dandali** (96) , tuni taron jama’a ya taru a kan **gefen hanya** (46) da a kan **babbar hanya** (47) . **Ma’aikatan gidan waya** (44) da **masu kai wasiƙa** (45) suna fitowa daga gidan wayar. **Matuƙin tiram** (48) ya tilasta tsayar da abin hawansa domin ya bar **motar asibiti** (50) ta gari ta wuce, wadda take zuwa da **likitan tiyata** (52) da **ma’aikacin jinya** (51) domin su kula da **wanda ya ji rauni** (53) da aka kawo a kan **shimfiɗar ɗauka** (54) kusa da **rumfar jarida** (55) .
t11-c2-02-1: 2. — Wata rundunar sojojin ƙasa, wadda take dawowa daga atisaye, ta tsaya domin ta tabbatar da tsari tare da **ƴan sandan doki na gari** (61) . **Masu hawan dokin,** waɗanda dawakansu suke tashi a tsaye, sun fi **sojoji** (57) ko **ƴan sanda** (63) mayar da **masu kallo** (56) baya. Ban da haka ƴan sandan suna cikin aiki ƙwarai. Ɗaya daga cikinsu yana nuna wa **ƴan sandan gari** (64) inda ya kamata a kai wani **wanda ya sami hatsari** (65) , mai kashe gobara mai jaruntaka wanda ya faɗi daga tsani.
t11-c2-03-1: 3. — **Jami’i** (66) yana ƙayyade wurin da ya kamata a ajiye **famfon tururi** (67) da yake zuwa. Yana jiran wannan babbar na’ura, sai ya sa aka kafa **famfon hannu** (68) da gaggawa, wanda doguwar **bututunsa** (69) yake jefa ruwa kamar gudun ruwa a kan wutar. Masu kashe gobara shida suna motsa shi, alhali abokinsu, wanda yake riƙe da **bakin famfo** (70) , yake jagorantar **yayyafin ruwa** (71) zuwa tsakiyar gobarar.
t11-c2-04-1: 4. — A ɗaya gefen gidan wasan kwaikwayo, an jingina babban **tsani** (72) . Yana ba da damar masu kashe gobara su kusanci harsunan wuta da suke fitowa cikin guguwar baƙin **hayaƙi** (75) .
t11-c2-05-1: 5. — **Gobara** (74) ta tashi a ɗakin hutu na **gidan wasan kwaikwayo** (73) , alhali ana yin maimaicin **wasan waƙa** wanda **wasansa** na farko zai kasance gobe. Da sa’a **masu kallo** (76) kaɗan kaɗai suke cikin zauren. Waɗannan masu tausayi sun gudu zuwa **baranda** (77) inda **masu kashe gobara** (86) masu jaruntaka suke zuwa su ceto su da tsani da manyan igiyoyi.
t11-c2-06-1: 6. — A ƙarƙashin **shirayi** (78) , inda **talla** (79) yake sanar da wasan, muna ganin **makaɗa** (81) na **ƙungiyar makaɗa** (80) suna gudu, suna ɗauke da kayan kiɗansu : **bayolin** (81) , da **sarewa** (82) , da **babban bayolin** (83) , da **babbar busa** (84) , da **ganga** (85) , da sauransu. Ana ƙoƙarin ceto ɓangaren **kayan gida** (87) .
t11-c2-07-1: 7. — **Ƴan wasa maza** (89) da **ƴan wasa mata** (88) , da **mawaƙa maza** da **mawaƙa mata** sun tilasta gudu da **kayan wasansu** (90) . Mawaƙi mai murya yana bayyana wa **ɗan jarida** (92) yadda abin ya faru. **Mai bayar da rahoto** ya gaggauta zuwa tun daga farko tare da masu mulki : **gwamna** (91) , da **magajin gari** (93) , da **kwamishinan ƴan sanda** (94) da **jami’in shari’a** (95) , waɗanda za su yi bincike domin su yanke hukunci a kan alhakin.
t12-apar-1: HOTO Na 12 Tasha. — Layin dogo. — Jiragen ruwa. Bayani. — *Jadawalin lokuta da ake amfani da su a kowace ƙasa sun bambanta, don haka muna amfani a matsayin misali da lokutan* **jadawalin Faransa.**
t12-01-1: 1. — Na yi tafiya ta Jamus yanzu. Kafin tashi, na sayi **littafin lokutan jirgi** (15) domin in san lokacin tashin jiragen ƙasa. Bayan na tabbatar cewa jirgin da ya fi dacewa zai tashi daga Paris, ƙarfe tara na dare, kuma zai iso Strasburg ƙarfe ɗaya da minti goma sha uku, sai na shirya tafiyata, kuma washegari, na sa aka kai ni tasha.
t12-02-1: 2. — Lokacin da na shiga babban zauren tashi, a bayan tsohon **malamin coci** (2) na ƙauye, wanda yake ɗauke da **jakar tafiyarsa** (3) a hannu, **matafiya** (1) da yawa sun riga sun iso.
t12-02-2: Tun da nake son aika **waya** (5) , sai na sa **mai duba** (6) ya nuna mini **ofishin waya** (4) .
t12-03-1: 3. — Kafin in shiga **ɗakin jira** (7) , na je na sami **tikiti** (9) na zuwa da dawowa.
t12-04-1: 4. — Ban daɗe ina jira a **taga sayarwa** (8) ba, domin mutane kaɗan ne a can. **Soja** (10) , wanda yake tafiya hutu, ya yarda ya ba ni wurinsa, ta yadda na sami isasshen lokaci in tambayi **shugaban tasha** (13) waɗansu bayanai, shi wanda yake hira da **kwamishinan** (12) sa ido da **ɗan sanda** (11) mai aiki.
t12-05-1: 5. — Bayan na sayi jarida a **kantin littattafai** (14) , na sa aka auna **kayana** (17) da **ɗan ɗako** (16) ya kawo yanzu a kan **amalanke** (19) ; **ma’aikacin ofis** (22) da aka danƙa wa **ma’auni** (21) ya sanar da ni cewa akwatina yana da nauyin kilogiram talatin da biyar ; wannan ya yi **ƙarin nauyi** na kilogiram biyar, wanda dole in ƙara biya a kansa, a **taga** kaya (23) .
t12-06-1: 6. — Tun da na yi da wuri ƙwarai, na sami lokacin duba yawon matafiya a tashar. Waɗansu sun ajiye ko sun karɓi ƙananan kayansu a **wurin ajiye kaya** (25) ; waɗansu suna duba **jadawalin lokuta** (26) . Matafiya masu iso suna gaggawar zuwa **mafita** (32) da **jakar kayansu** (24) a hannu. Waɗansu suna jira a **wurin karɓar kaya** (27) suna kuma gabatar da **tikitinsu** (29) domin su karɓi akwatunansu, ko **akwatuna** (28) ko **kwanduna** (30) .
t12-07-1: 7. — **Ma’aikatan haraji** (33) sun bincika ɗamummukan da kula domin su tabbatar ko mutum yana da abin da ya kamata ya bayyana.
t12-08-1: 8. — Waɗansu matafiya sun nufi **gidan abinci** (34) , inda **ma’aikaci** (35) yake himma wajen yi musu hidima. Dole su yi gaggawa, domin **jirgin ƙasa** (36) , wanda yake mai sauri, ba zai daɗe a tashar ba.
t12-09-1: 9. — Sa’an nan na nufi dandalin tashi na kuma nemi **koci** (37) kai tsaye domin kada a tilasta mini canja koci a lokacin tafiya. Na hau motar mai hanya wadda take ɗauke da **ɗaki** (38) domin masu shan taba da ɗaki da aka keɓe domin « mata kaɗai ».
t12-10-1: 10. — Bayan na hau **matakin hawa** (40) , na rufe **ƙofa** (39) , na naɗe **labule** (41) na kuma ajiye ƙananan kayana a kan **raga** (43) , sai na zauna a kan **kujera** (42) . Ina ganin **mai kula da fitilu** (44) yana kunna fitilu, sai na yi tunani cewa dole in kwana a cikin kocin, na kuma kira ma’aikacin da aka danƙa wa hayar **matashin kai** (45) domin in nemi ɗaya daga cikinsu.
t12-11-1: 11. — Mai duba tikiti ya zo ya tabbatar da tikitoci. Na tambaye shi me ya sa ba mu tashi ba tukuna, tun da lokacin daidai ne. Ya amsa mini cewa **shugaban jirgi** (46) yana cikin sa kekuna a cikin **kocin kaya** (47) . Ban da haka, ba a riga an canja dukan abin ɗumama ƙafa ba (48) .
t12-12-1: 12. — Amma ba da daɗewa ba za mu tashi, domin **mai wuta** (50) , a kan **kocin gawayinsa** (49) , ya ɗauki gawayi domin ya ƙarfafa wutar **injin jirgi** (54) , **matuƙin jirgi** (51) kuwa yana jiran alamar **mataimakin shugaban tasha** (52) kaɗai, wanda yake kan **dandali** (53) .
t12-13-1: 13. — **Tukunyar tururi** (56) ta injin jirgin tana ƙara da laushi ; **bututun hayaƙi** (55) yana amayar da gudun hayaƙi gauraye da **tururi** (60) . **Busa** (59) mai kaifi ta yi ƙara, **sandunan turawa** (58) kuwa suka fara motsi, suna tura **kekunan** (57) na’urar mai nauyi.
t12-14-1: 14. — Saurin jirgin, yana gudu a kan **layin dogo** (64) , ya ƙaru ; **dandaloli** (65) suka ɓace ; muka wuce **bayan gida** (66) , da kuma jerin kociyoyi da aka ajiye a ɗayan **layi** (63) : **kocin kwana** (67) , da **kocin cin abinci** (68) , da **kocin waya** (69) .
t12-15-1: 15. — Sa’an nan, **tashar kaya** (71) ta wuce a gaban idanunmu. A ƙarƙashin rumfuna, ma’aikata suna ɗora **kayayyakin** (72) da aka aika da jirgi mara sauri. **Ma’aikatan layi** (76) kusa da **tankin ruwa** (73) suna motsa **kocin dabbobi** (75) da **kocin ɗaukar kaya masu faɗi** (79) domin su yi **jirgin kaya** (80) .
t12-16-1: 16. — Mun ƙetare **mahaɗar layi** (78) ta ƙarshe, wadda mai canja layi yake tsaye kusa da ita ; mun wuce **alamar sigina** (86) tashar kuwa ta ɓace can nesa.
t12-17-1: 17. — Ba da daɗewa ba muka ƙetare **gadar ƙarfe** (74) wadda take ƙetare **babban kogi** (81) . Bayan mun ƙetare wannan gada, muka bi kogin, inda **jiragen jan wasu** (82) masu ƙarfi suke jan **jiragen kaya** (83) masu nauyi. Mun kuma ga **jirgin matafiya** (84) , lokacin da yake sauka a **gadar sauka** (85) .
t12-18-1: 18. — Bayan mun wuce tashoshi da yawa da sauri ƙwarai, muka ƙetare waɗansu **tanel** (87) muka kuma bar a bayanmu **ƙananan gidaje** marasa iyaka (88) na **masu gadin layi.** Girgizar jirgin ta yi mini rarrashi, sai na yi barci mai zurfi.
t12-19-1: 19. — Muryar wani ma’aikaci da yake kira ta farkar da ni ba zato ba tsammani : « Deutsch-Avricourt ! (*) . Kowa ya sauka ! » Sai aka yi binciken kwastan da dukan sharuɗɗan iyaka masu gundura. Dole in daidaita agogon aljihuna da **babban agogo** (89) na tashar, wanda ya yi gaba da minti hamsin da biyar ; da ƙyar na farka, na kasa rarrabe **babbar allura** (90) da **ƙaramar** (91) ; **allon lambobi** (92) da kansa ya rikice gaba ɗaya saboda hazon safiya.
t12-20-1: 20. — Alhali ma’aikatan kwastan suna binciken, ni kuwa ina hamma na karanta **tallace-tallace** (93) da suka yi wa bangayen tashar ado. Na ci abincin safe domin in shafe lokaci, na duba taswirar **layukan jirgin ƙasa** (94) na Jamus domin in ga nisan da ya rage tsakanina da Strasburg, na kuma sake shiga kocina, ina da ƙarfin bege na kai wa ga makasudin tafiyata ba da daɗewa ba.
t13-apar-1: HOTO Na 13 Otal. — Gidan cin abinci. — Gidan kofi.
t13-01-1: 1. — Da na iso Royan jiya da yamma, na sauka a « *Otal na Babban Teku* » wanda wani aboki ya ba ni shawarar zuwa.
t13-01-2: An ba ni kyakkyawan **ɗaki** (2) , a kan **bene** (1) na biyu inda na yi barci sosai (*) .
t13-02-1: 2. — Yau da safe, ina fitowa daga ɗakina, inda **mai aikin gida** (3) ta kawo ƙaramin abincin safe, sai na shiga **ɗakin shan taba** (5) wanda ake amfani da shi a matsayin **ɗakin karatu** (4) domin karanta **jaridu** (6) , ana shan **taba** (8) . Bayan na karanta, na sauka da **lif** (9) na kuma je yawo cikin garin.
t13-03-1: 3. — Tun da na manta in tambayi **ma’aikacin ofis** (12) na otal ɗin ko a wane lokaci ake ba da abinci a kan **teburin gamayya** (11) , sai na komo da wuri na kuma yi amfani da hakan in je in yi wanka a **ɗakin wanka** (10) na otal ɗin. Sa’an nan na sake zuwa **ofishin kuɗi** (15) domin in yi wa ɗaya daga cikin abokaina waya. Amma ana amfani da **tarho** (13) ; da ta ga na kunce, **ma’aikaciyar kuɗi** (14) , wadda take rubuta **lissafi** (17) a kan **littafin matafiya** (16) , sai ta roƙi **mai gadin ƙofa** (18) ya aiki **ɗan aike** (19) ya yi mini saƙo **a kan keke** (20) .
t13-04-1: 4. — Na gode mata na kuma fita domin in ba da ɗan kyauta ga **ɗan ɗako** (24) wanda ya kawo daga tashar a kan **amalankensa** (25) **akwatin hulata** (26) , da **jakar kayana** (27) da **jakar tafiyata** (28) . **Mai kai wasiƙa** (21) , wanda ya iso yanzu, ya ba ni **wasiƙa** (22) .
t13-05-1: 5. — Na ɗan daɗe a bakin ƙofa, kusa da **akwatin wasiƙa** (23) , ina kallon zirga-zirga a kan hanya. **Matuƙin** (30) **babbar motar haya** (29) yana ɗora a kan abin hawansa **akwatin** (31) wani **matafiyi** (32) wanda **mai otal** (33) yake raka. Wani matashin **mai waya** (35) ya kawo **waya** (34) ba tare da gaggawa ba domin wani abokin cinikin otal ; wani **matafiyi** (36) da **kyamararsa** (38) a kafaɗa, yana duba **littafin jagorarsa** (37) .
t13-06-1: 6. — A gaban shingen, wani **ɗan aike** (39) marar damuwa yana gyangyaɗi tsakanin **ƙugiyar ɗaukarsa** (40) da **akwatin gogen takalminsa** (41) , alhali wata matashiyar **mai wanki** (42) , wadda take ɗauke da **kwando** (43) na tufafi, take dariya saboda fuskar tsanani ta **ma’aikacin tebur** (44) wanda yake tsaye kusa da ƙofar.
t13-07-1: 7. — Ina ganin **mai girki** (45) , wanda ya fito daga **ɗakin girkinsa** (47) da yake a **benen ƙarƙashin ƙasa** (48) domin ya aiki **mai wanke kwanuka** (46) ya yi saƙo, sai na tuna cewa lokacin abincin rana ya kusa, sai na shiga gidan cin abinci, ina ƙetare farfajiya inda **matuƙin mota** (50) ya ajiye **motarsa** (49) , alhali **makanike** (52) yake gyara, bisa ga umarnin **mai keke** (53) , **keke mai ƙafa uku** (51) wanda ya sami hatsari yanzu.
t13-08-1: 8. — Na tambayi matashin **ɗan aike** (54) wanda yake ɗauke da **gilashin giya** (55) , ko teburin gamayya yana ƙarƙashin baranda, kuma saboda amsarsa ta tabbatarwa, sai na sami wuri a kan ɗaya daga cikin teburoci na kuma sa aka ba ni abinci mai kyau ƙwarai.
t13-09-1: 9. — Ma’aikacin ya kawo mini jerin abinci (*) na rana da jerin giya. Na zaɓa na kuma yi oda na **jatan lande** a matsayin **abin buɗe ci** tare da **man shanu,** kuma, a matsayin abincin farko, **tumbi bisa ga salon Caen.** Ban ci **kifi** ba, sai dai na nemi rabo na **cinyar** ɗan tunkiya, kuma, a matsayin **kwanon ganyayyaki, alayyaho** da kirim. Sa’an nan, tun da babu ɗaya daga cikin **abinci na tsakiya** da ya ba ni sha’awa, sai na sa aka kawo mini kayan zaki iri iri, **cuku,** da **ƴaƴan itace** da **biskit.** Na ƙara kuma **giyar** Saint-Emilion mai kyau ƙwarai, kuma na gamsu ƙwarai da abincina sai na bar teburin bayan na ba **ma’aikaci** (57) kyakkyawan **kyauta** (59) .
t13-10-1: 10. — Ina ganin ni a shirye domin tafiya, sai **manaja** (60) ya ba ni shawara in je baranda domin in yaba wa kallon **Babban Teku** (62) mai kyau ƙwarai. Can nesa sai muka fara ganin **ƙananan jiragen** kamun kifi (63) , da **jiragen ruwa masu zanen iska** (64) da babban **jirgin fasinja** (65) wanda baƙin siffarsa yake bayyana a kan farin **gajimare** (67) na **iyakar ido** (66) . Iska mai laushi ta sa **tuta** (70) da aka kafa a saman **alama** (69) ta **zauren** (68) ta yi motsi.
t13-11-1: 11. — Kallon ya ba da sha’awa ƙwarai, har na yanke shawara in hau kan dandalin gidan kofi gobe ina ɗauke da **ƙaramin madubin gani** (71) ko **madubin gani mai nisa** (72) .
t13-12-1: 12. — Ina barin baranda, na nufi gidan kofi na otal ɗin domin in sha **abin sha** (73) , ina wasan **biliyad** (75) . Ba tare da tsayawa ba na ƙetare zauren kofi inda masu sha da yawa suke wasan **sadaranji** (78) , da **wasan faifai** (79) , da **domino** (80) , da **wasan tebur** (81) ko da **kati** (82) , na kuma hau **ɗakin biliyad** (74) kai tsaye.
t13-13-1: 13. — Lokacin da wasan ya ƙare, na sauka zuwa benen ƙasa na kuma nemi wurin ma’aikaci **ambulan** (84) , da **takarda** (83) , da **kan sarki** (85) , da **alƙalami** (87) da **tawada** (86) domin in rubuta wasiƙa.
t13-13-2: Sa’an nan na kira **matuƙi** (92) wanda **abin hawansa** (88) ya tsaya gaban gidan kofi. Na tambaye shi farashi bisa ga sa’o’i ko na tafiya ɗaya, kuma, lokacin da muka yarda a kan farashin, sai ya buɗe mini **ƙofar abin hawa** (89) ya zaunar da ni. Ya sake hawa **mazauninsa** (91) , ya tada dawakin da sauri da **ƙaramin bulala** (93) sai muka tafi yawo mai kwarjini.
t14-01-1: 1. — Abokina Ioannes, wanda yake zaune a ƙauye, ya zo ya yi kwana uku a iyalina. **Har wancan lokaci** bai sami damar ganin babban gari ba ; shi ya sa muke amfani da dukan kwanakinmu muna yawo, ni kuwa ina bayyana masa abin da bai sani ba.
t14-02-1: 2. — Da farko mun je mun ziyarci **wurin lura da taurari** (1) , wanda ya ba shi sha’awa ƙwarai. Muna dawowa ta **titi** (3) inda **wankan Turkiyya** (2) yake, sai muka haɗu da **jana’iza** (4) . A gaban **tawagar jana’izar** akwai **malaman coci** suna tafiya, a gaban **motar gawa,** inda aka ajiye **akwatin gawa.** Abokai da yawa sun raka iyalin **masu makoki.**
t14-02-2: Bayan tawagar ta wuce, muka ƙetare titin gaban babban **gidan giya** (5) inda **masu sha** da yawa suke shan **giya** a kan dandali, **rufin gilashi** (6) yana kare su.
t14-03-1: 3. — Ioannes ya yi mamaki ƙwarai da **garkuwa** da aka ajiye tsakanin shagon **mai sayar da giya** (7) da na **mai sayar da kayan kiɗa** (10) . Ya tambaye ni ma’anarta ; na amsa masa cewa tana nuna **ofishin jakadanci** (8) na Ingila, na kuma sa ya lura da **jakada** (9) wanda yake kan baranda.
t14-04-1: 4. — Ba shakka mun tsaya gaban wurin baje **kayan kiɗa,** da **harmoni,** da **organ** da **fiyano** ; muka kalli murfin **littattafan waƙa** masu hoto da na kiɗan fiyano, muka kuma yaba wa **kayan kiɗa mai zare** na katakon zinare, wanda ake amfani da shi a matsayin alama.
t14-05-1: 5. — Gizagizan ƙura da **masu share titi** (11) da **motar share titi** (12) suka tayar ya tilasta mana mu wuce da sauri gaban kyawawan **kayan gida** na **mai sayar da kayan gida** (13) da gaban wurin baje **murhuna** da **fitilu** na **mai aikin kwano** (14) .
t14-06-1: 6. — Ban da haka, a wannan wuri, an tilasta mana mu bar gefen hanyar, domin ɗamummuka sun cika shi, waɗanda aka sauke daga **motar jigila** (16) domin a ajiye su a cikin **shago** (15) da aka yi hayarsa yanzu.
t14-06-2: Wannan ya hana mu ganin kyawawan motocin **mai yin motoci** (17) , amma bai hana mu tsayawa mu kalli **mai yin akwati** (19) yana yin akwati domin maƙwabcinsa, **mai sayar da kekuna da motoci** (18) . Sa’an nan, tun da ya riga ya yi ɗan makara, sai muka koma gida.
t14-07-1: 7. — Washegari, mahaifiyata ta ba Ioannes shawara a ɗauki hotonsa, sa’an nan ta danƙa mini in raka shi wurin **mai ɗaukar hoto** (20) . Bayan abincin rana, muka shiga **ɗakin aikin** mai fasahar, inda aka tilasta mana jira mai tsawo sosai. Domin mu shagaltar da kanmu, sai muka kalli **hotuna** (22) da suke rataye a bango.
t14-07-2: Lokacin da lokacinmu ya yi, aikin bai daɗe ba, kuma nan take da abokina ya gama tsayawa gaban **kyamara** (21) , sai muka sauka.
t14-08-1: 8. — A kan bene na farko, muka gani ta ƙofar **mai gyaran gashi** (23) , wadda take a buɗe, ɗan aikinsa yana yanke gashin wani abokin ciniki.
t14-08-2: Da muka iso titin, muka wuce gaban **shagon taba** (24) . Ioannes ya ji daɗin **fitilar hannu** ja (25) da **babban bututun taba** da ake amfani da shi a matsayin **alama** (26) ƙwarai, har ya yi karo da wasu tsofaffin malamai biyu waɗanda suke hira suna **shan taba ta hanci** (27) .
t14-09-1: 9. — **Takardun kuɗi** da **tsabar kuɗi** na kowace ƙasa da aka baje a **tagar shago** ta **mai canjin kuɗi** (29) sun ja hankalinmu na ɗan lokaci, amma tun da lokacin ƙaramin abinci ne, sai muka shiga wurin **mai yin kek** (31) ba tare da ƙara tsayawa ba.
t14-10-1: 10. — Muna ganin dukan **kayan zaki** da shagon yake ɗauke da su, wato **kek,** da **kek na zuma,** da **biskit** da **alewa** iri iri, sai muka kasa zaɓi cikin sauƙi. A ƙarshe Ioannes ya zaɓi **kek na kirim,** ni kuwa na ɗauki **ƙaramin kek na ceri** kaɗai, domin kayan zaki suna **ba ni ciwon haƙori,** ni kuma ba na son zuwa wurin **likitan haƙori** (30) sau da yawa ko kaɗan.
t14-11-1: 11. — Domin in nuna wa abokina **injin buga rubutu** wanda ya ji labarinsa, amma wanda bai sani ba, sai muka shiga **ofishin** (32) **ɗan baffana** (34) . Muka same shi yana rubuta wasiƙunsa ga **sakatarensa** (35) wanda yake **mai gaggauta rubutu.** Da ƙyar wasiƙa ta ƙare, **mai buga rubutu** (33) ya sake kwafinta da injinsa. Tun da ba ma son katse aikin ɗan uwana, sai muka yi ɗan lokaci kaɗai a wurinsa.
t14-12-1: 12. — A ƙarƙashin ofishin ɗan baffana, akwai babban **mai sayar da agogo da kayan ado** (37) wanda yake kuma **maƙerin zinare.** Shagonsa mai kyau yana ɗauke da **agogo,** da **agogo masu lilo,** da **agogon aljihu,** da **sarƙoƙi** da **kayan ado** masu tsada, alal misali **sarƙar lu’ulu’u,** da **munduwar** zinare, da **ƴan kunne** da **zobba** da aka yi musu ado da **duwatsu masu daraja** da **lu’ulu’u masu ƙyalli.** An keɓe ɗaya daga cikin tagogin domin **kayan zinare** kuma yana ɗauke da babban tarin **kayan ci** na azurfa.
t14-13-1: 13. — Muna juyawa a kusurwar titin, na lura cewa an canja **allon suna** (36) da aka ajiye kusa da **lambar** gidan. Zan faɗi abin da na lura da babbar murya, sai aka ji sautin kiɗan **sojoji** masu farin ciki. Muka fara gudu don haɗuwa da rundunar, ba tare da mun yi tunani cewa **ita** za ta wuce gaban shagunan **mai sayar da huluna** (39) da na **mai sayar da safar hannu** (40) ba, kuma cewa da mun kasance a wuri mai kyau haka domin mu ga faretinta idan muka tsaya gaban tagar **mai sayar da tabarau** (38) , wanda yake cike da **tabarau mai maƙale,** da **tabarau mai hannu** da **ƙananan madubin gani.**
t14-14-1: 14. — A gaban **rundunar sojoji** (41) akwai **shugaban makaɗa** (42) yana tafiya, **masu ganga** (43) suka bi shi, da **masu busa** (44) da dukan **ƙungiyar makaɗa.** **Janar** (45) , wanda yake kan filin tare da mataimakinsa, ya tsaya kusa da **bakin ruwa** (49) na **marmaro** (48) , domin ya halarci **faretin.**
t14-14-2: **Manyan jami’ai** (46) , da **kanar** da **mataimakin kanar** sun gaishe shi da takobi. **Manjo** yana gaban **bataliyoninsa** (47) kuma kowane **kyaftin** yana jagorantar **kamfaninsa,** alhali **laftanoni,** da **ƙananan laftanoni** da **sajanoni** suka riƙe wurarensu na saba kusa da mutanensu.
t14-15-1: 15. — Masu wucewa da yawa sun taru a kan **mahaɗar hanyoyi** (50) ; ƴan kasuwa, da **mai gyaran laima** (51) , da **marini** (53) , da **maƙerin makamai** (54) sun fito domin su ga **sojoji.** Dukan abin hawa, wato **kekunan doki** (52) , da **motoci masu mastu** (57) da kuma **motar shayar da titi** (56) , sun ajiye kansu a gefen hanyar.
t14-15-2: **Ɗan kasuwa mai yawo** (55) da yake ɗauke da **akwatunan samfurinsa** a hannu, ya ƙetare titin da sauri, mutanen da suke zaune a kan **benen sama** (59) na **babbar motar haya** (58) kuwa suka juya domin su ji daɗin abin kallon. **Mawaƙin titi** (60) mai tausayi da **injin waƙarsa mai juyawa** (61) ya tilasta katse **waƙarsa,** domin hayaniyar ganguna ta rufe muryarsa.
t14-16-1: 16. — Lokacin da rundunar ta iso gaban **shagon yadi** (64) , **mata masu ɗinki** (63) da **maɗinka** (62) sun bar **kekunan ɗinkinsu** da aikinsu domin su kalla ta taga. **Ɗan kasuwa** (65) , wanda ya ajiye sabbin **kaya** (66) a **wurin baje kayansa** yanzu, ya tilasta sa **yadudduka** (67) da zannuwan da aka kafa a gefen hanya, kusa da **bakin magudanar ruwa** (68) , a ciki, don tsoron kada taron ya kife su ; har tsoho **mai sayarwa mai yawo** (69) , wanda wata mai gadin ƙofa take ciniki da shi a kan safa, an tilasta masa ya shiga wata hanya domin ya gama sayarwarsa.
t14-16-2: Mun raka rundunar har bariki, **kuma,** muna gamsuwa ƙwarai da yininmu, muka komo a lokacin abincin dare.
t14-17-1: 17. — Washegari, mahaifina ya ba mu shawara mu ziyarci gidan bugu na jaridar wurin. Mun karɓa da farin ciki.
t14-17-2: **Mai bugu** shi ne kuma **mai sayar da littattafai** (70) , da **mai fitar da littattafai,** da **mai sayar da takarda** da **mai ɗaure littattafai.** Ya kafa a bene na farko **ofishin edita** (71) na jaridar, da kuma **ɗakin zana,** inda **masu zana a kan dutse** (72) da **masu zana a kan jan ƙarfe** (73) suke aiki, a ƙarshe kuma **ɗakin tsara haruffa,** inda **ma’aikatan bugu** (74) suke. **Wurin bugu** (75) da kansa, da **injinan bugu** da injina iri iri suna a benen ƙasa.
t14-tit-9: Ioannes yana tambaya da yawa ƙwarai.
t14-18-1: 18. — Muna fitowa daga gidan bugun, Ioannes ya tsaya cikin mamaki ƙwarai gaban ƙaramin akwati na gilashi da aka ajiye a kan ginshiƙi, a gaban **shagon ƙananan kaya** (77) , ya kuma tambayi me ake amfani da shi. Mahaifina ya bayyana masa cewa **na’urar sanar da gobara** (76) ce. Ban da haka kome, a cikin garin, abin mamaki ne ga abokina, tun daga **marmaron dutse** (78) mai sauƙi da **keke mai ƙafa uku na kaya** (80) mai sauƙi da **ɗan aike** (79) sanye da kayan aiki yake tuƙa shi, har zuwa **motar waya** (81) .
t14-19-1: 19. — Alhali mahaifina ya bar mu na ɗan lokaci domin ya yi magana da **mai karɓar haraji** (83) , wanda ya tsaya domin ya yi hira da **lauya** (82) da **magatakarda** (84) , sai muka shagaltar da kanmu muna bin zirga-zirga a kan titin da idanunmu. Mutane iri iri sun wuce a gabanmu : **ɗan aiken mai yin kek** (85) , yana ɗauke da **kek mai daɗi** mai kyau cikin kwando, ya biyo bayan **mai sayar da tufafi** (86) ; **mai kunna fitilu** (87) yana hira da **ma’aikacin gas** (88) , **ƴar’uwar addini** (89) wadda take riƙe da hannun wata maraya tana komawa gidan ƴan’uwan cocinta.
t14-20-1: 20. — A daidai lokacin da mahaifina ya haɗu da mu, Ioannes ya yi dariya ƙwarai, yana ganin fuska mai ƙazanta da tufafi masu ban mamaki na **masu tsaftace bututun hayaƙi** (91) biyu cike da kirin.
t14-21-1: 21. — Na so in saya wurin **mai sayar da furanni** (92) tsiro domin mahaifiyata, amma mahaifina ya sa na lura cewa zai yi nauyi ƙwarai a ɗauka kuma cewa ya fi kyau a sayi **lemu.** Muka kusanci **mai sayarwa** (94) kuma lokacin da **malamar gida** (93) , wadda take zaɓi domin ɗalibarta, ta gama sayenta, sai muka sa aka yi mana hidima.
t14-22-1: 22. — Muna dawowa gida, muka haɗu da waɗansu sanannu : tsohuwar abokiyar iyalina, wadda ta jingina hannunta a kan **abokiyar zamanta** (95) , da **injiniyan** (96) gadoji da hanyoyi, da ɗaya daga cikin ƴan goggona tare da **mai kula da yaranta** (98) .
t14-22-2: Sa’an nan muka haɗu da **mai yin huluna** (97) na mahaifiyata da **malaman addini** (99) biyu baƙi ga garin, waɗanda suka zo wurinmu domin su tambayi mahaifina hanyar zuwa tasha.
t15-01-1: 1. — Yawancin ƴan kasuwa da suke ba mu kayayyakin da suke buƙata domin abincinmu suna taruwa a ƙarƙashin **babbar rumfar** (1) **kasuwa mai rufi** ko a titunan da suke kusa.
t15-02-1: 2. — **Mai sayar da naman alade** (2) , wanda yake sayar da **gasasshen naman alade** (3) , da **tsiran jini** (4) , da **ƙaramin tsira** (5) , da **tsiran tumbi** (6) da **kitsen alade** (7) , yana tsaye kusa da **mai sayar da man shanu da cuku** (8) , wadda wurin baje kayanta yake cike da **cukun Holand** (9) mai jan ɓawo, da **cukun Camembert** (10) , da **faifan Gruyère** (11) da **gunduwoyin man shanu** (12) sabbi.
t15-03-1: 3. — A gabanta, **mai sayar da ganyayyaki** (13) tana gabatar wa abokan cinikinta kyawawan **tumatir** (14) , da **kabejin fure** (15) , da **salati** (16) , da **kabeji** (17) , da **kabewa** (19) , da **kankana** (18) har ma da **naman kaza** (20) . Amma **ɗan aiken giya,** wanda ya tsayar da **motar kai kayansa** (21) cike da **gangunan giya** (22) , daidai gaban wurin baje kayanta, yana hana abokan cinikinta kusatowa. Wata mai lambu tana kawo mata kwando na **artichok** (23) .
t15-04-1: 4. — A kasuwa, hargitsi yana da yawa, domin lokacin **sayarwa ta gwanjo** (24) ya yi. **Uwayen gida** (26) , waɗanda suke zuwa can domin sayayyarsu, suna tsayawa suna wucewa gaban shagon **mai sayar da tumbi** (25) , domin su sayi **tumbin ciki** ko **kan ɗan sa.**
t15-05-1: 5. — Wani **mai girki** (27) mai ƙiba yana ciniki a kan **kifin tuna** mai kyau ƙwarai wurin **mai sayar da kifi** (28) wadda take ƙara farashinta yadda ta ga dama. Ta karɓi yawan **kifin maciji, da kifin lebur, da kifin kogi** da **karfa.** **Kifinta na gishiri** da **katantanwar ruwanta** suna da sabo ƙwarai.
t15-tit-3: Kaya masu arha da masu tsada.
t15-06-1: 6. — **Mai sayar da tsuntsaye** (29) , wadda ta zauna kusa da ita, tana da gaskiya ƙwarai. Idan tana sayar da **talotalo,** ko **babbar agwagwa,** ko **agwagwa** ko **ɗan kaza** kawai, tana neman farashi mai adalci kaɗai.
t15-07-1: 7. — A kusurwar filin, a bene na farko, tun ba da daɗewa ba, an kafa **mai sayar da yadi** (30) wanda mata masu saye kullum suke da tabbacin samun kyakkyawan zaɓi na **zanen tebur,** da **ƙananan tawul,** da **afaro** da **abin share kwanuka** wurinsa. A wannan bene, **maƙerin wuƙaƙe** (31) ya kafa ɗakin aikinsa. Yana wasa **wuƙaƙen** masu sayarwa a cikin rumfar kasuwa yana kuma yi wa masu lambu **lauje** da **ƙarfe** mafi tauri.
t15-08-1: 8. — A ƙarƙashin ɗakin aikinsa, tun ba da daɗewa ba, an buɗe babban shagon abinci. Ba **shagon kayan miya** (32) mai sauƙi kuma marar muhimmanci na dā ba ne kuma, wanda yake sayar da kayayyaki na kowa kaɗai, wato **shayi** (33) , da **cakulet** (34) , da **sukari gunduwa** (37) da **sabulu** (38) . A can ana sayar da kowane iri kaya, wato **biskit,** da **kayan gwangwani** (35) , da **giya mai zaƙi** (36) , da **rum,** da **konyak,** da **kirsh,** da **giyar anisi** da **kurasao.** A can ana samun naman daji : **zomon daji** (39) , da **tsuntsayen daji** (40) , da **makwarwa** (41) , da **ƙananan makwarwa** (42) , da **agwagwar daji** (43) ko **zabo** (44) , cikin sauƙi kamar ƴaƴan itacen ƙasashen waje kamar **ayaba** (46) da **abarba.**
t15-09-1: 9. — **Ɗan aiken** (45) mai sayar da kayan miya, mai taimako ƙwarai, yana a shirye ya ba da abin da mutum yake so : **jam** (47) na kurant ko na kwins, da **kitse** (48) , da **ƙananan gurji** (49) ko **sardin** (50) mai gishiri.
t15-09-2: Wannan yana da amfani ƙwarai ga **mata masu saye** (51) , waɗanda suke samu, kusa da kayayyaki na kowa, abin da ya fi wuya da ƴaƴan itace da suka fi daɗi : **fir** (52) mai ruwa, da **furam** (53) , da **inabi** (54) , da **fis** (55) , da **lauje** (56) da **wolnat** (57) .
t15-10-1: 10. — **Shinkafa** (58) da **ƙananan wake** (59) suna kusa da akwatin **haring** (60) da aka gasa da hayaƙi ; **dankalin turawa** (61) da **wake** (63) suna kusa da **tuffa** (62) , da **ɓaure** (64) , da **busasshen furam** (65) da **gyaɗar Turai** (66) . Ana samun a wannan shago sabbin **ƙwai** (67) da **zaitun** (68) ; shi ya sa **kwanduna** (70) da **ragunan sayayya** (73) suke cika da sauri ƙwarai.
t15-11-1: 11. — **Kofi** (72) na wannan kamfani mai kyau ƙwarai ya sami suna mai adalci tsakanin **ma’aikatan gida** (69) da **masu girki,** domin tsoho **mai sayar da kayan miya** (71) da kansa yakan soya shi da kula ƙwarai.
t15-12-1: 12. — Ba kowa ne yake zuwa kasuwa domin ya yi sayayya ba. A cikin zirga-zirga mai ban sha’awa a kan ƙaramar hanyar da take kai wa rumfar kasuwa, mutum yana ganin mutane iri iri ƙwarai. Kusa da **ɗan aiken mahauci** (75) mai kirki, wanda yake tura **amalanke** (74) a gabansa, ga sojoji biyu masu hutu suna alfahari ƙwarai da nuna kayan aikinsu masu ƙyalli : **sojan doki** (76) da shuɗiyar **rigarsa** da **hular gashin tsuntsu,** da **sajan zuwaf,** mai gajeren wando mai kumbura da kai a rufe da **hular fez.**
t15-13-1: 13. — **Mai gasa burodi** (80) , wanda yake tsaye a bakin **gidan gasa burodi** (78) , ya gama kwaɓa garin **burodinsa** (79) ya kuma ɗauko daga tanda **burodi mai lanƙwasa** (81) , da **ƙananan burodi** (82) da **burodi mai zagaye** (83) waɗanda suke a tagar shagon.
t15-14-1: 14. — A saman gidan gasa burodin, akwai gwaniyar **mai ɗinkin farar kaya** (84) zaune, wadda take ɗaukar **mata masu ɗinkin ado** (85) da yawa. Kusa da ita akwai **mai wanki da goge tufafi** (86) zaune, wadda take sa sitaci a **farar kaya** (88) bayan ta wanke ta kuma shanya ta, kuma wadda take goge ta da **ƙarfen goge tufafi** (87) .
t15-15-1: 15. — A **mahauta** (89) , wadda take a benen ƙasa, ana sayar da kowane iri **nama, naman tunkiya** (90) , da **naman sa** (94) ko **naman ɗan sa** (92) a matsayin **cinyar tunkiya, da yankan nama, da gasasshen nama** da **yankan haƙarƙari.** **Ɗan aiken mahauci** (93) yana yayyanka dukan waɗannan nama yana kuma ware **ƙasusuwan ɓargo** (96) . A ƙofar mahautar akwai **mai sayar da ƙwarƙwaran teku** (97) wadda take sayar da **ƙwarƙwaran teku** (98) . Tana buɗe su idan mutum yana so.
t15-16-1: 16. — Dukan waɗannan ƴan kasuwa suna biyan lasisi ko harajin wuri ; shi ya sa **ɗan sanda** (100) yake korar **matan sayar da ganyayyaki masu yawo** (99) masu tausayi ba tare da tausayi ba, waɗanda suke yi musu takara suna kai **karas, da ƙananan raɗis, da turnif, da albasa mai tsawo** ko **ɗamin asfaragas, da ƙananan wake, da alayyaho, da yakuwa, da ganyen ruwa** da **ganyen ƙamshi** a kan ƙananan abin hawansu.
t15-17-1: 17. — Yaron da yake sayar da **tafarnuwa** (101) da **albasa,** ya san sarai cewa shi ma, ba shi da izinin sayar da kayansa kusa da kasuwar. Yana gudu, yana gaggawa cikin haɗarin kife kwandon **ƙaguwa,** da **ƙaguwar ruwa** da **jatan lande** na **mai sayar da** (102) **manyan jatan lande** da **jatan lande masu ƙafa.**
t15-18-1: 18. — Kowa yana hargitsi yana kuma hayaniya ƙwarai ; amma wannan ba ya hana a ji muryar **mai sa gilashi** (103) mai yawo sarai, ko kiran **mai sayar da gawayi** (104) wanda ya bar karusarsa na ɗan lokaci domin ya kai **ƙaramin buhun gawayi** (105) .
t16-apar-1: HOTO Na 16 Babban shago. — Kasuwar biki. — Kayan wasa.
t16-01-1: 1. — Sabuwar shekara tana gabatowa. Manyan shaguna sun shirya wuraren baje **kayan wasansu** (1) da kyautuka na sabuwar shekara.
t16-01-2: Na roƙi kakana ya kai ni kasuwar biki domin in ga wannan kyakkyawan wurin baje koli, shi kuwa ya yarda.
t16-02-1: 2. — Da farko muka tsaya gaban kyawawan garkuwoyin makamai, waɗanda suke ɗauke da **bindiga,** da **hular soja,** da **takobi mai lanƙwasa,** da **ɗamarar takobi** da **alamun kafaɗa** biyu, ko **hular ƙarfe,** da **sulke** (3) da **ƙaramar bindiga** (4) . Dukan wannan ya ba ni sha’awa fiye da **fitilun haske** (2) ƙwarai.
t16-03-1: 3. — A wannan sashe akwai **mai gadi** (5) a cikin **rumfarsa** ; ya yi kama da wanda yake gadi gaban dukan gidan namun daji na kwali. Kai, dabbobi nawa ne a can : **aku** (6) a kan sandarsa, da **karkanda** (7) mai ƙaho a kan hanci, da **barewar ƙasar sanyi** (8) , da **jimina** (9) , da **biri** (10) yana karya goro, da **dila** (11) yana ɗauke da kaza, da **kada** (12) yana buɗe manyan muƙamuƙansa, da **raƙumi mai tozo biyu** (13) , da **karen farauta mai sirara** (14) mai kwarjini, da **baƙar damisa** (15) , sa’an nan dabbobi biyu da ban sani ba waɗanda, bisa ga faɗa, su ne **ƙaramar dabba mai tsawo** (16) da **kura** (17) . Akwai kuma a can **damisa** (18) da **kerkeci** (21) ; kusa ƙwarai akwai kyawawan **ƙananan kusu** (19) da **ƙananan ɓera** (20) na roba. A ƙarshe **dorina** (22) da **raƙumi** (23) mai tozo suka gama tarin. Da ma zan zauna a can na sa’o’i da yawa da ba a kusa da can akwai kyakkyawan **sansani** cike da **sojojin dalma** (29) wanda ya ja hankalina ba.
t16-04-1: 4. — Kakana, wanda yake **naƙasasshe** (24) kuma wanda ya tilasta barin soja saboda **rauni** da ya sa ya sami **lambar yabo ta soja,** yana son ya ba ni labarin **yaƙe-yaƙen** da ya shiga ƙwarai. Yana farin ciki yana bayyana mini motsi iri iri na ƙaramar rundunar nan ƙanƙanuwa. Wata ƙungiyar sojoji na gaskiya da suke ziyartar kasuwar bikin, wato **soja mai gini** (25) , da **mafarautan duwatsu** (26) da kansa a rufe da **hula mai laushi,** da **babban sajan** (27) na sojojin ƙasa da **sajan igwa** (28) mai **alamar** zinare a hannun riga, sun tsaya kusa da mu domin su saurari bayanan.
t16-05-1: 5. — Kakana, cikin alfahari ƙwarai, tun da yake yana da masu sauraro masu haske haka, sai ya ƙirƙiri cikakken shirin fada nan take.
t16-05-2: Garin da aka yi wa ganuwa, tare da **ganuwarsa** da **ramukansa,** **rundunar abokan gaba** ta yi masa **ƙawanya,** wadda, bayan **harbin igwa** mai tsawon lokaci, ta kasance a shirye ta yi **hari.** Amma **waɗanda aka yi wa ƙawanya,** da yunwa ta tilasta musu, sun yi ƙoƙarin **fita da fada** zuwa **sansanin masu ƙawanyar.** Bayan sun fatattaki **harin** da **fada** mai tsanani kewaye da **sansanin,** masu ƙawanyar da suka **yi nasara** sun saki **sojojin dokinsu** domin su kori **waɗanda aka ci da yaƙi.** Waɗannan sun **ja da baya** suna rufe **filin fada** da **matattu** da **waɗanda suka ji rauni.** **Masu ɗaukar rauni** sun kai waɗannan na ƙarshe zuwa **motar asibiti** domin **likitan tiyata** ya kula da su.
t16-05-3: Duk da tsayin daka na jaruntaka na waɗansu **bataliyoni** da suka yi **murabba’i,** **shan kaye** ya cika, sauran rundunar sun **gudu,** suna barin **kamammu** da yawa. Abokan gaba sun je su cika **nasararsu** suna mamaye garin. Wataƙila wannan zai zama ƙarshen yaƙin kuma, bayan **tsagaita wuta,** zai yiwu a sa hannu a kan **yarjejeniyar zaman lafiya.**
t16-06-1: 6. — Matasan sojojin, waɗanda suka yi dariya suna sauraron labarin tsohon sojan mai ban sha’awa, sun tambaye shi waɗansu bayanai. Game da ni, na zagaya wurin sayarwa domin in kalli kyakkyawan **bakan harbi** (32) da **baka** (33) tare da **kibiyarsa** (31) . A can na sami wani tarin dabbobi : **tsuntsayen waƙa** (34) biyu, wato **tsuntsun waƙar dare** na inji da **tsuntsun kurmi** yana waƙa da dukan maƙogwaronsa, da kuma jerin dabbobi masu ban mamaki : **jemage** (35) , da **mesa** (36) , da **kunkuru** (37) , da **karen teku** (38) , da **babban kifin teku** (39) da **kifi mai cin mutane** (40) na kwali.
t16-07-1: 7. — Ban daɗe ina kallonsu ba, domin na hangi abin da nake mafarki : kyakkyawan **gidan wasan ƴan tsana** (41) tare da kyawawan **kayan ado** da **labule** ja mai ban sha’awa. A kan **fage,** ƴan wasa biyu sun yi kama da masu yin **rawar gani** a cikin **wasan kwaikwayo** mai ban sha’awa ƙwarai, domin ƙananan **masu kallo** na kwali da aka ajiye a cikin ɗakuna ko zaune a kan **manyan kujeru** da a **benen ƙasa** a bayan **shugaban ƙungiyar makaɗa,** sun yi ta tafi da ƙarfi.
t16-07-2: Abin baƙin ciki, wannan gidan wasan yana da tsada ƙwarai.
t16-08-1: 8. — Ban da haka, zaɓen kayan wasa yana da wuya, domin a cikin tagogin an tara kowane iri kayan wasa : **Arlekino** (42) , da **Fulcinelo** (43) , da **Fiyero** (44) , da **mujiyoyi** (45) suna kaɗa fikafikai, da **baƙaƙen tsuntsu** (46) masu busa, da **ƙananan karnuka** masu haushi, da **injin waƙa** (47) da **kayan wasa na haƙuri.** Ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan kayan wasa ya ba ni daɗi ƙwarai : yana nuna **fadar jiragen ruwa** (48) inda **ƴan fashin teku** suke kai wa wani **jirgin ruwa** hari kusa da ƙasa da aka shuka **itatuwan kwakwa.**
t16-09-1: 9. — Na iya kallon dukan waɗannan abubuwan mamaki cikin sauƙi ƙwarai, domin mutane kaɗan ne kaɗai suke a shagon, da ƙyar waɗansu masu yawo, da **sojan doki** (49) da **mai karɓar kuɗi** (50) wanda ya gabatar da **takardar biya** a babbar **ofishin kuɗi** (51) .
t16-10-1: 10. — Na tambayi kakana amfanin littattafan da aka ajiye a kan kantuna a bayan **ma’aikaciyar kuɗi** ; ya amsa mini cewa **littattafan lissafi** ne.
t16-11-1: 11. — Muna barin sashen kayan wasa, sai muka nufi shagon sirdi domin mu duba **sirduna** (53) , da **ƙafafun sirdi** (54) , da **linzamai** (55) , da **bakunan linzami** (56) da **bulaloli.** Alhali **shugaban sashe** (57) yake ba kakana waɗansu bayanai, sai na je na kalli wurin baje **kwanukan fenti** da **gilashi** (58) inda kyawawan **kwanonin salati** da **tukwanen shayi** (59) masu laushi suke.
t16-12-1: 12. — Domin mu je bene na farko, muka wuce a bayan tagar **matsattsun riguna** (60) , kusa da wurin sayar da safa, inda aka baje kyawawan **wanduna** (63) ƙwarai. A kusa, wata **ma’aikaciyar shago** (61) tana sa wata **mai saye** (62) ta zaɓi kyawawan **saƙaƙƙun yadi** (64) na siliki.
t16-12-2: Muna hawan matakala, na lura cewa an yi wa shagon ado da **fitilun hannu** (65) na Japan, da **laimu** (66) da manyan **itatuwan dabino** (70) .
t16-13-1: 13. — A bene na farko, ba abin gani da yawa ; kayan gida kaɗai (*) , da **akwatunan ƙarfe** (67) , da **kabad masu aljihu** (68) da **abin hawan yara** (69) . Amma kallon shagon gaba ɗaya yana da **daɗi** ƙwarai.
t16-14-1: 14. — A ƙafafunmu, na ga kayan kiɗa : **harfa** (71) , da **gita** (72) , da **mandolin** (73) , da **ƙananan busa** (74) , da **sarewa masu ƙara** (75) , da bayolin tare da **sandarsu** (76) har ma da **babbar ganga** (77) . Ɗan kaɗan can nesa, a sashen takarda, wani **ɗalibi** (78) yana ciniki da **ma’aikacin shago** (79) a kan jakar littattafai. Kusa da su, na rarrabe kyakkyawan **littafin haruffa** (80) .
t16-14-2: A tsakiyar shagon an kafa doguwar **bishiyar Kirsimeti** (81) cike da kyandirori, da ƙananan abubuwa da kowane iri kayan wasa : **dawakin katako** (82) , da **ƴan tsana** (83) , da sauransu.
t16-14-3: **Wurin sayar da turare** (84) tare da **maganin haƙori** da **turare** iri iri ya baza ƙamshi mai kyau ƙwarai wanda ya iso gare mu.
t16-15-1: 15. — Tun da kakana ya fara ganin lokacin ya yi tsawo ƙwarai, sai muka sauka da babbar matakala. Ya ɗan tsaya gaban **allon ilimin taurari** (85) wanda yake nuna, ya gaya mini, **taurari masu wutsiya** (a) , da **husufin wata da na rana** (b) , da fitowar iska tare da **ɓangarori huɗu na duniya** (c) **(Arewa, Kudu, Gabas da Yamma)**, da taswirar **rabin duniya** biyu (d) , da **taurarin masu zagayawa** (e) da **tsarin rana** (f) . Ban gane komai a cikin dukan wannan ba, kuma kayan aikin **ɗan aiken kai kaya** (86) mai alamun zinare wanda ya wuce ya fi ba ni sha’awa, da kyawawan **fankunan hannu** (87) da suke kusa da ni, kusa da **jakunan kuɗi** (88) da **jakunan takarda** (89) .
t16-16-1: 16. — Na kuma yaba wa **gashin tsuntsu** (90) a kan wurin baje kayan, da **ƙyalluran ɗamara** (91) , da kyawawan **furannin ƙera** (94) da aka tsara cikin kwanduna da kwarjini. **Furen bayolet,** da **furen ƙamshi,** da **furen hiyasint** (95) , da **furen jeraniyo** (96) , da **furen lili** (97) da **furen nasturshin** (98) an kwafe su da kyau ƙwarai.
t16-17-1: 17. — Na roƙi kakana ya saya mini ɗaya daga cikin **buroshin haƙori** (92) da suke cikin akwati kusa da **allurar gashi** (93) . Ya yarda ni kuwa na je da kaina na biya sayena a ofishin kuɗi, kusa da inda ake shirya babban **kaya** (100) domin wani **abokin ciniki** (99) .
t16-18-1: 18. — Ba zato ba tsammani wani ɗan hargitsi ya tashi tsakanin mutanen da suka tsaya kusa da **kayan tagulla** (101) na fasaha. An kama **ɓarawo** (102) yanzu, cikin laifinsa, da **mai duba** (103) , alhali yake ƙoƙarin yi wa wani sata. An kula a kawo ɗan sanda domin ya **kama** shi, kuma daidai lokacin da muka fita, ana kai mai laifin zuwa kurkuku.
